title.zh: 公共负担：领福利会影响绿卡吗？（2026年新规）
title.en: Public charge: will benefits affect my green card? (2026 rule)

short.zh: 2026年9月18日起规定改变，申请绿卡前必读
short.en: Rules changed Sept 18, 2026: read before applying for a green card

summary.zh: “公共负担”是移民局审查**绿卡申请**时，判断申请人将来会不会依赖政府福利的标准。**2026 年 9 月 18 日起规定改变了**：旧规只看现金补助和长期护理，新规下白卡、粮食券、WIC、公屋等以收入审核的福利都**可能**被考虑。但很多人**根本不受公共负担影响**，先看下面谁不受影响。
summary.en: "Public charge" is the test immigration officers use on **green card applications** to judge whether someone may depend on government benefits. **It changed on September 18, 2026**: the old rule counted only cash aid and long-term care; under the new approach, means-tested benefits such as Medicaid, SNAP, WIC and public housing **may** be considered. But many people **aren't subject to public charge at all**; check below first.

zh: 2026 年 7 月 20 日联邦公布最终规定，**废除 2022 年的规则**，改由移民官员**综合个案判断**，没有固定清单。
**2026 年 9 月 18 日或之后**递交的绿卡申请适用新标准；之前递交的仍按旧规。
**9 月 18 日以前领取的福利**，仍按旧规判断：只有现金补助（SSI、TANF 等）和长期护理才算。
纽约州联合二十多个州和华盛顿特区起诉，纽约市等城市另案起诉；截至本文核实时，法院尚未阻止新规。
en: A final rule published July 20, 2026 **rescinded the 2022 rule**; officers now decide **case by case** with no fixed list.
Green card applications filed **on or after Sept 18, 2026** use the new standard; earlier filings use the old rule.
**Benefits received before Sept 18, 2026** are still judged under the old rule: only cash aid (SSI, TANF, etc.) and long-term care count.
New York, about 20 other states and DC have sued, and NYC and other cities filed a separate suit; no court had blocked the rule when this was checked.

zh: **不受公共负担影响的人**：已经有绿卡、申请入籍（入籍不审查公共负担）、难民、庇护者、SIJ 少年、T 签证和 U 签证持有人、VAWA 自我申请者等
**主要受影响**：通过亲属移民或其他途径**正在或准备申请绿卡**的人
**一般不算福利**：社安退休金、政府退休金、失业金、退伍军人福利等非收入审核的项目
移民官员**可能**会把申请人有法律责任照顾的家人（例如美国出生的孩子）领的福利也算进去；但不要自行停掉孩子的福利，先咨询免费律师
en: **Not subject to public charge**: people who already have a green card, naturalization applicants, refugees, asylees, SIJ youth, T and U visa holders, VAWA self-petitioners and others
**Mainly affected**: people **applying or planning to apply for a green card** through family or other routes
**Not counted**: Social Security, government pensions, unemployment insurance, veterans' benefits and other non-means-tested benefits

Officers **may** count benefits used by family members the applicant is legally responsible for (e.g., U.S.-citizen children); don't drop your children's benefits on your own, talk to a free lawyer first

zh: **第一步：先判断你受不受影响。**已经有绿卡、准备入籍的，不受影响。难民、庇护者、T 签证、U 签证、VAWA 自我申请、SIJ 少年转绿卡，以及 DACA、TPS 申请或续期，一般也不审查。
**会被审查的主要是**：通过亲属、雇主或抽签**申请绿卡（I-485）**的人、申请签证入境的人，以及**出国 180 天或以上**再回美国的绿卡持有人。
**第二步：看你的申请日期。**2026 年 9 月 18 日或之后递交的绿卡申请适用新标准；之前递交的可能适用不同规则。9 月 18 日以前领的福利，只看现金补助和长期护理。
**第三步：打免费热线问清楚。**纽约市移民法律支援热线 **800-354-0365**（免费、保密、有翻译），或打 **311** 说 “Immigration Legal”；也可以打纽约州新美国人热线 **1-800-566-7636**（匿名）。接通后说 “Chinese, please”。
**打电话前先写下来**：你现在是什么身份、准备申请什么、什么时候递交、全家谁在领什么福利（白卡、粮食券、WIC、公屋等）、从什么时候开始领。
**第四步：不要自己停掉福利。**市政府明确建议：在跟可信的法律服务人员谈过之前，**不要停用你或家人需要的福利和市政府服务**。孩子的保险和食物补助尤其不要贸然退掉。
**急诊、疫苗、学校午餐等基本保障**，不要因为害怕而放弃。
热线会给你资讯，并可能转介免费律师；不保证一定有人接你的全部案子，所以**早点打**。
en: **Step 1: Check whether you're affected.** Green card holders applying for citizenship are not. Green cards through refugee or asylee status, T or U visas, VAWA self-petitions or SIJ status, and DACA or TPS applications and renewals, generally aren't reviewed either.

**Mainly reviewed**: people **applying for a green card (I-485)** through family, an employer or the lottery, people applying for visas to enter, and green card holders returning after **180 days or more** abroad.

**Step 2: Look at your filing date.** Green card applications filed on or after Sept 18, 2026 use the new standard; earlier filings may follow different rules. Benefits used before Sept 18 count only if they were cash aid or long-term care.

**Step 3: Call a free hotline.** NYC Immigration Legal Support Hotline **800-354-0365** (free, confidential, interpreters available), or call **311** and say "Immigration Legal"; or the NYS New Americans Hotline **1-800-566-7636** (anonymous). When connected, say "Chinese, please".
**Before you call, write down**: your current status, what you plan to apply for and when, and who in your family uses which benefits (Medicaid, SNAP, WIC, public housing, etc.) and since when.

**Step 4: Don't drop benefits on your own.** The City's advice is clear: **don't stop benefits or City services you or your family need** until you've talked to a trusted legal provider. Be especially careful not to cancel children's coverage or food help.
**Don't skip emergency care, vaccines or school meals** out of fear.
The hotline gives information and may refer you to a free lawyer; full representation isn't guaranteed, so **call early**.

label.zh: 纽约州新美国人热线（免费、匿名，有中文）
纽约市移民法律支援热线（有中文）

zh: “领了福利就不能入籍”：入籍不审查公共负担
“有绿卡的人领福利会被取消绿卡”：公共负担主要审查申请绿卡的人，已有绿卡者一般不受影响；但**出国超过 180 天**再入境时，可能被当作重新申请入境而接受审查
“新规公布后以前领的都算”：9 月 18 日前领的按旧规，只有现金补助和长期护理算
en: "Benefits block citizenship": naturalization has no public charge test

"Green card holders lose their cards for using benefits": the test mainly applies to green card applicants; but a green card holder returning from **more than 180 days abroad** can be treated as seeking admission and face it
"Everything I used before counts now": benefits before Sept 18, 2026 are judged under the old rule

sources.name: 联邦公报：公共负担最终规定（2026-07-20）
纽约市移民事务办公室：公共负担（2026-10-23 更新）
纽约市移民法律支援热线
纽约州新美国人办公室

zh: **打完热线之后**：热线本身不直接代理案子，也不帮你约时间；他们会告诉你去哪里找可信的免费法律服务。按他们给的转介联系机构。
**跟律师谈时**：带上你的移民文件、福利批准信或通知、全家收入资料。律师会根据**你自己的情况**告诉你该怎么做。
**规定还在变**：多个州和城市已起诉，市政府说会持续更新资讯。递交绿卡申请前，再上 **nyc.gov/publiccharge** 看最新消息。
你领福利的资格本身**没有改变**；能不能继续领、要不要继续领，要听律师按个案的意见。
en: **After calling**: the hotline doesn't represent you or book appointments; it tells you where to find trusted free legal help. Contact the place they refer you to.
**When you see a lawyer**: bring your immigration papers, benefit approval letters or notices, and household income records. The lawyer will advise you based on **your own situation**.
**The rules are still changing**: states and cities have sued, and the City says it will keep updating its information. Check **nyc.gov/publiccharge** again before filing a green card application.
Your eligibility for benefits itself **hasn't changed**; whether to keep using them is a case-by-case decision to make with a lawyer.

zh: **社安金和联邦医疗保险（Medicare）不是以收入审核的福利**，不算在内。
家人领福利**不会自动**让你成为公共负担；但如果你对那个人有法律上的扶养责任，可能会被考虑。先问律师，再决定。
网上和微信群里的传言很多，以 nyc.gov/publiccharge 和免费热线说的为准。
有人收钱说能“包你不受影响”或“帮你删掉福利记录”，都是骗局。
en: **Social Security and Medicare are not means-tested** and don't count.
A relative's benefits **don't automatically** make you a public charge, but they may be considered if you're legally responsible for supporting that person. Ask a lawyer before deciding anything.
There are many rumors online and in WeChat groups; trust nyc.gov/publiccharge and the free hotlines.
Anyone charging money to "guarantee you're safe" or "erase your benefit records" is running a scam.

title.zh: 申请入籍（N-400）

short.zh: 绿卡满5年（配偶3年）可申请；费用可能大涨
short.en: Green card 5 years (3 if married to a citizen); fees may rise sharply

summary.zh: 持绿卡满 **5 年**（与美国公民结婚并同住满 **3 年**）就可以申请入籍，可提前 90 天递交。入籍后可以投票、为父母子女申请绿卡、拿美国护照。**移民局已提议大幅提高入籍费并取消大部分减费**，打算申请的人值得早做准备。
summary.en: After **5 years** with a green card (**3 years** if married to and living with a U.S. citizen) you can apply for citizenship, up to 90 days early. Citizens can vote, sponsor parents and children, and get a U.S. passport. **USCIS has proposed a big fee increase and ending most reduced fees**, so plan ahead.

zh: **费用提案（尚未定案）**：入籍费拟提高到网上 $1,280、纸本 $1,330，并**取消大部分减费和免费申请**。
**新公民考试**：2025 年 10 月 20 日或之后递交的申请，用新版考试：从 128 题中考 20 题，答对 12 题及格。
据报道 2026 年第二季度入籍批准数大跌，排队案件增加，审理可能变慢。
en: **Fee proposal (not final)**: $1,280 online and $1,330 on paper, **ending most reduced fees and fee waivers**.
**New civics test**: applications filed on or after Oct 20, 2025 take the 2025 test: 20 questions from 128, 12 correct to pass.
Reports say approvals dropped sharply in spring 2026 and backlogs grew, so processing may be slower.

zh: 18 岁以上
绿卡满 5 年；或与公民结婚同住满 3 年
过去 5 年内在美国住满 30 个月（3 年途径为 18 个月）
出境 1 年以上会中断连续居住；6–12 个月可能被认为中断
递交前在本州住满 3 个月
**英文考试豁免**：50 岁以上且绿卡满 20 年，或 55 岁以上且满 15 年，可以免考英文；65 岁以上且满 20 年，公民考试题目更少，可用母语
en: Age 18+
Green card 5 years, or 3 years married to and living with a citizen
Physically present 30 months of the last 5 years (18 of 3)
A trip of 1 year+ breaks continuous residence; 6–12 months may
3 months in your state before filing
**English exemptions**: 50+ with 20 years as a green card holder, or 55+ with 15 years; 65+ with 20 years gets a shorter civics test in their own language

zh: **先算日子**：拿绿卡满 5 年（与公民结婚同住满 3 年）。绿卡上的 “Resident Since” 日期就是起算日，可以提前 90 天递交。过去 5 年出国超过 6 个月的，先问免费律师。
**找免费帮手**：打 **311** 说 “ActionNYC”，或打纽约州新美国人热线 **1-800-566-7636**，说 “Chinese, please”。他们可以免费帮你看资格、填 N-400（入籍申请表）。
**准备文件**：绿卡正反面复印件、过去 5 年每次出入境的日期、婚姻证明（3 年途径）、报税记录；曾被逮捕或上过法庭的，要准备法庭文件。
**网上递交最便宜**：在 USCIS（移民局）网站建立网上账户（online account），网上填写并递交 N-400。现在费用：网上 $710、纸本 $760；收入在贫困线 150–400% 可申请减费 $380（以 USCIS 官网为准）。
**付款**：2025 年 10 月 28 日起移民局**不收支票和汇票**，要用信用卡、借记卡或银行转账。
**收到收据通知（receipt notice）**：上面有 13 位的**收据号码（receipt number）**。拍照保存，以后查进度用。
**指纹预约（biometrics，移民局采集指纹和照片）**：会寄来预约通知（I-797C）。按上面的日期、时间、地点去，带**预约通知和绿卡**（或护照）。去不了，一定要**在预约时间之前**打 USCIS 客服 **1-800-375-5283** 改期，并说明正当理由。
**入籍面谈（interview）**：会寄来面谈通知。带上**面谈通知、绿卡、护照**和申请时交过的文件原件。官员会让你宣誓说真话，逐项问 N-400 的内容，并考英文（说、读一句、写一句）和公民考试（2025 年 10 月 20 日或之后递交的：从 128 题中问 20 题，答对 12 题及格）。符合年龄和绿卡年限豁免的，可以免考英文。
**宣誓典礼（oath ceremony）**：获批后，有时当天就能宣誓，否则会寄通知。当天要交回绿卡、填 N-445 问卷、宣誓，拿到**入籍证书（Certificate of Naturalization）**。离开前检查证书上的名字和日期，有错当场说。
en: **Count your time**: 5 years with a green card (3 if married to and living with a citizen). The "Resident Since" date on your green card is the start date; you can file up to 90 days early. If you were abroad more than 6 months at a time in the last 5 years, ask a free lawyer first.

**Get free help**: call **311** and say "ActionNYC", or call the NYS New Americans Hotline at **1-800-566-7636** and say "Chinese, please". They can check your eligibility and help fill out the N-400 (citizenship application) for free.

**Gather documents**: copies of both sides of your green card, the dates of every trip in the last 5 years, marriage proof (3-year route), tax records, and court papers if you were ever arrested or went to court.
**Filing online is cheapest**: create a USCIS online account and file N-400 online. Current fee: $710 online, $760 paper; $380 reduced fee for income 150–400% of poverty (confirm on uscis.gov).
**Payment**: since Oct 28, 2025 USCIS **doesn't accept checks or money orders**; pay by credit or debit card or bank transfer.
**Receipt notice**: it has a 13-character **receipt number**. Take a photo; you'll use it to check your status.

**Biometrics appointment** (USCIS takes your fingerprints and photo): you'll get a notice (I-797C). Go on the date, time and place shown and bring **the notice and your green card** (or passport). If you can't go, call the USCIS Contact Center at **1-800-375-5283** **before the appointment time** to reschedule, with a good reason.

**Interview**: you'll get an interview notice. Bring **the notice, your green card, passport** and originals of documents you submitted. The officer puts you under oath, goes through your N-400, and gives the English test (speaking, reading one sentence, writing one sentence) and the civics test (filed on or after Oct 20, 2025: 20 questions from 128, 12 correct to pass). If you qualify for an age-and-years exemption, you can skip the English test.

**Oath ceremony**: once approved, you may take the oath the same day, or get a notice by mail. At the ceremony you hand back your green card, complete the N-445 questionnaire, take the oath and receive your **Certificate of Naturalization**. Check the name and dates before you leave and report errors on the spot.

zh: 绿卡正反面
过去 5 年的出入境记录
婚姻证明（3 年途径）
报税记录，如有逮捕或法庭记录要准备文件
en: Green card (both sides)
Travel history for 5 years
Marriage proof (3-year route)
Tax records; court records if you were ever arrested

zh: “领过福利不能入籍”：入籍不审查公共负担
“找中介比律师好”：只有律师或司法部认可代表才能代理，中介只能填表翻译
en: "Benefits block citizenship": naturalization has no public charge test
"A notario is as good as a lawyer": only lawyers or DOJ-accredited representatives may represent you

sources.name: USCIS 政策手册：面谈结果与重考
USCIS 政策手册：拒绝后申请复审（N-336）

zh: **查进度**：在 **egov.uscis.gov/casestatus** 输入 13 位收据号码；或登录你的 USCIS 网上账户看通知；或打 1-800-375-5283。等待时间可在 USCIS 处理时间网页（processing times）查，超过时间还没消息，可以网上提出查询。
**面谈当天的结果**：官员会给你一张结果通知（N-652）。可能是**批准**、**延期**（例如要补文件，会发 N-14 补件通知，一般 30 天内要回复），或**拒绝**。
**考试没过**：会给你**第二次机会**，一般在 60 到 90 天内重考没过的部分。
移民局一般要在**第一次面谈后 120 天内**作出决定。
**被拒绝怎么办**：可以在收到拒绝通知后 **30 天内**（邮寄的话 33 天）交 **N-336** 表要求复审听证，费用 $700；不能网上交。超过期限会被拒收。一定先找免费律师帮你看。
en: **Check status**: enter your 13-character receipt number at **egov.uscis.gov/casestatus**, log in to your USCIS online account, or call 1-800-375-5283. See typical wait times on the USCIS processing times page; if your case is past that time, you can submit an online inquiry.

**Result at the interview**: the officer gives you a results notice (N-652). It may be **approved**, **continued** (for example, you need to send more documents; you'll get an N-14 request and usually have 30 days to respond), or **denied**.
**If you fail a test**: you get a **second chance**, usually within 60 to 90 days, to retake the part you failed.
USCIS generally must decide **within 120 days of your first interview**.

**If denied**: you can file **Form N-336** within **30 days** of receiving the denial (33 if it was mailed) to ask for a hearing. The fee is $700 and it can't be filed online. Late filings are rejected. See a free lawyer first.

zh: **早点开始练习**：用 USCIS 网站的公民考试学习材料练习，请家人每天问你几题。
**说真话、跟申请表一致**：面谈时官员会对照你的 N-400 问，答案不一致会有麻烦。逮捕、出国、报税等问题，不确定就先问律师。
入籍**不审查公共负担**，领过白卡、粮食券不影响入籍。
搬家后要在 USCIS 网上改地址，否则面谈通知可能寄不到。
只找律师或司法部认可的代表办案。中介只能帮你填表翻译。
en: **Start practicing early**: use the USCIS civics study materials and have family quiz you a few questions every day.
**Tell the truth and match your form**: the officer checks your answers against your N-400. If you're unsure about arrests, trips or taxes, ask a lawyer first.
Naturalization has **no public charge test**; having used Medicaid or SNAP doesn't block citizenship.
If you move, change your address online with USCIS, or your interview notice may not reach you.
Only let a lawyer or DOJ-accredited representative handle your case. A notario may only fill forms and translate.

title.zh: 申请绿卡（I-485 调整身份）基本知识
title.en: Green card basics (I-485 adjustment of status)

short.zh: 主要途径、费用和2026年新变化
short.en: Main paths, fees and 2026 changes

summary.zh: 在美国境内申请绿卡叫“调整身份”（I-485）。主要途径有**亲属移民、职业移民、难民/庇护转绿卡、抽签**等。成人 I-485 费用 **$1,440**。2026 年有新表格版本和公共负担新规，递交前务必确认。
summary.en: Applying for a green card from inside the U.S. is "adjustment of status" (I-485). Main paths are **family, employment, refugee/asylum, and the diversity lottery**. The adult I-485 fee is **$1,440**. A new form edition and public charge rule took effect in 2026, so double-check before filing.

zh: **2026 年 9 月 18 日起只收新版 I-485**（版本日期 09/18/26），旧版会被退回，没有宽限期。
同日起适用新的公共负担标准，请先看《公共负担》指南。
部分国家国民的申请被暂停审理；据报道中国、香港、澳门不在名单上。
en: **Only the 09/18/26 edition of I-485 is accepted from Sept 18, 2026**; older editions are rejected, with no grace period.
The new public charge standard applies from the same date; see our public charge guide.
Cases from some travel-ban countries were put on hold; China, Hong Kong and Macau are reported not to be on the list.

zh: 亲属移民：**美国公民**可以为配偶、子女、父母（公民须满 21 岁）、兄弟姐妹申请；**绿卡持有人只能为配偶和未婚子女申请**
职业移民：雇主担保或特殊人才
难民和庇护者：获批 1 年后可申请
抽签移民：国务院推迟了 2027 年度（DV-2027）登记；法院已下令 2026 年 11 月 1 日起开放 30 天，但政府已上诉，请以国务院官方公告为准
en: Family: **U.S. citizens** can sponsor spouses, children, parents (if the citizen is 21+) and siblings; **green card holders can sponsor only spouses and unmarried children**
Employment: employer-sponsored or extraordinary ability
Refugees and asylees: after 1 year

Diversity lottery: the State Department delayed DV-2027 registration; a court ordered it to open Nov 1, 2026 for 30 days, but the government has appealed. Follow the State Department's official notice

zh: **先确认你走哪条路**：亲属移民、职业移民、难民/庇护转绿卡等。走亲属或职业移民的，先查每月的**签证公告（Visa Bulletin）**，看你的排期日（priority date）到了没有。
**递交前先打免费热线**：纽约州新美国人热线 **1-800-566-7636** 或纽约市移民法律支援热线 **800-354-0365**，说 “Chinese, please”。2026 年 9 月 18 日起有新的公共负担标准，正在领福利的更要先问。
**用最新版表格**：2026 年 9 月 18 日起只收版本日期 09/18/26 的 I-485，旧版会被退回。在 uscis.gov/i-485 下载，并按你的类别找正确的递交地址。
**准备文件**：护照、出生证明、I-94 入境记录、照片、体检表 I-693（找移民局指定医生做）、经济担保 I-864、亲属关系或工作证明。外文文件要附英文翻译。
**一起递交工卡和回美证**（如需要）：工卡（I-765）随 I-485 $260、回美证（advance parole，I-131）$630；I-485 成人 $1,440（以 USCIS 官网为准）。只能用信用卡或银行转账付款。
**签名**：每份表格都要签名，没签名会被退件。全部复印一套自己留着。
**收到收据通知**：记下 13 位收据号码，拍照保存。
**指纹预约（biometrics，移民局采集指纹、照片和签名）**：按通知去，带**预约通知和带照片的身份证件**（例如护照）。去不了，**在预约之前**打 **1-800-375-5283** 改期。没去又没改期，申请可能会被当作放弃而被拒绝。
**面谈（如果需要）**：不是每个人都要面谈。有面谈的话，要宣誓回答问题，并带上**所有递交过的文件的原件**。
en: **Confirm your path**: family, employment, refugee/asylum and so on. For family or employment cases, check the monthly **Visa Bulletin** to see if your priority date is current.

**Call a free hotline before filing**: the NYS New Americans Hotline **1-800-566-7636** or the NYC Immigration Legal Support Hotline **800-354-0365**, and say "Chinese, please". A new public charge standard applies from Sept 18, 2026, so ask first if you use benefits.

**Use the current form**: from Sept 18, 2026 only the 09/18/26 edition of I-485 is accepted; older editions are rejected. Download it at uscis.gov/i-485 and find the right filing address for your category.

**Gather documents**: passport, birth certificate, I-94, photos, medical exam I-693 (from a USCIS-designated doctor), affidavit of support I-864, and proof of relationship or job. Foreign-language documents need English translations.

**File a work permit and travel document with it** if needed: work permit (I-765) with I-485 $260, advance parole (I-131) $630; I-485 adult $1,440 (confirm on uscis.gov). Pay by card or bank debit only.
**Sign**: sign every form; unsigned forms are rejected. Keep a full copy for yourself.
**Receipt notice**: write down the 13-character receipt number and take a photo.

**Biometrics** (USCIS takes fingerprints, photo and signature): go as the notice says and bring **the notice and a photo ID** (such as a passport). If you can't go, call **1-800-375-5283** **before the appointment** to reschedule. Missing it without rescheduling can get your case treated as abandoned and denied.
**Interview (if required)**: not everyone is interviewed. If you are, you'll answer questions under oath and must bring **originals of every document you submitted**.

zh: 护照、出生证明、I-94 入境记录
体检表 I-693
经济担保 I-864
照片
亲属关系或工作证明
en: Passport, birth certificate, I-94
Medical exam I-693
Affidavit of support I-864
Photos
Proof of relationship or job

zh: “交钱可以加快排期”：排期由法律和签证公告决定，任何人都不能收钱插队
“随便找人填表就好”：表格版本、付款方式出错都会被退件，复杂个案请找律师
en: "Pay to speed up": priority dates are set by law; nobody can sell you a faster place
"Anyone can fill the forms": wrong editions or payment methods get rejected; see a lawyer for complex cases

sources.name: USCIS 政策手册：离境与放弃申请

zh: **查进度**：在 **egov.uscis.gov/casestatus** 输入 13 位收据号码，可以订阅自动更新；或打 1-800-375-5283。可在 USCIS 处理时间网页查一般要等多久，超过时间可以网上提出查询。
**补件通知（RFE，Request for Evidence）**：移民局觉得缺文件时会寄来，**一定要在期限内回复**，否则可能被拒绝。
**等候期间不要随便出国**：I-485 审理中，没有先拿到回美证（advance parole）就离开美国，申请一般会被当作**放弃**。
**批准后**：先收到批准通知，过一段时间绿卡会寄到你家。搬家要上 USCIS 网上改地址，免得绿卡寄丢。
**被拒绝怎么办**：I-485 被拒绝一般**不能上诉**，但可能可以用 I-290B 表提出重新审理或重新考虑的动议（motion）。有期限，**马上找免费律师**。
en: **Check status**: enter your 13-character receipt number at **egov.uscis.gov/casestatus** and sign up for automatic updates, or call 1-800-375-5283. The USCIS processing times page shows typical waits; if you're past it, you can submit an online inquiry.
**Request for Evidence (RFE)**: if USCIS needs more documents it sends one. **Answer by the deadline**, or your case may be denied.
**Don't travel abroad casually while waiting**: if you leave the U.S. while your I-485 is pending without advance parole first, your application is generally treated as **abandoned**.
**After approval**: you get an approval notice first, and the green card arrives by mail a little later. If you move, change your address online with USCIS so the card isn't lost.
**If denied**: you generally **can't appeal** an I-485 denial, but you may be able to file a motion to reopen or reconsider on Form I-290B. There are deadlines, so **see a free lawyer right away**.

zh: 排期由法律和签证公告决定，**任何人都不能收钱帮你插队**。
把移民局的每一封信按日期放进同一个文件夹，信封也留着。
递交前请免费律师或 ActionNYC 帮你检查一次表格版本、签名和付款方式，这三样最常出错被退件。
已经领福利或打算申请福利的，不要自己停掉，先看《公共负担》指南并打免费热线。
en: Priority dates are set by law and the Visa Bulletin; **no one can sell you a faster place**.
Keep every USCIS letter in one folder by date, envelopes too.
Before filing, have a free lawyer or ActionNYC check the form edition, signatures and payment method; these are the most common reasons for rejection.
If you use or plan to use benefits, don't stop on your own; read our public charge guide and call a free hotline first.

title.zh: 免费移民法律帮助和防移民诈骗
title.en: Free immigration legal help and avoiding fraud

short.zh: 免费热线、中文服务机构，教你识别假律师
short.en: Free hotlines, Chinese-language groups, spotting fake lawyers

summary.zh: 移民案件出错可能影响一辈子。纽约州和纽约市都有**免费、保密、有中文**的移民法律热线，法拉盛、华埠也有多家中文非营利机构。注意：**公证人（notario）不是律师**，只有律师或司法部认可的代表才能代理移民案件。
summary.en: Immigration mistakes can last a lifetime. New York State and City run **free, confidential hotlines with Chinese**, and several Chinese-language nonprofits serve Flushing and Chinatown. Remember: **a notary ("notario") is not a lawyer**; only lawyers or DOJ-accredited representatives may handle immigration cases.

zh: 任何移民，不论身份
部分市政府法律中心服务收入在贫困线 200% 以内的家庭
en: Any immigrant, any status
Some City legal centers serve households under 200% of poverty

zh: **先打免费热线**：纽约州新美国人热线 **1-800-566-7636**（周一至五 8am–8pm，周末 9am–5pm，匿名、200 多种语言），或纽约市移民法律支援热线 **800-354-0365**（也可以打 311 说 “Immigration Legal”）。接通后说 “Chinese, please”。
纽约市热线时间：周一、周三 9am–8pm；周二、周四、周五 9am–6pm；每月最后一个星期六 9am–5pm。
**打之前先准备**：写下你的问题、你的身份、收到过哪些移民局或法庭的信，以及信上的日期和期限。手边准备纸笔。
**跟热线说清楚**：你住在哪一区、需要什么帮助（例如入籍、绿卡、收到法庭通知），有没有紧急期限。热线会告诉你去哪里找**市政府资助、免费、安全**的法律服务。
**办入籍或绿卡**：打 **311** 说 “ActionNYC”，预约免费协助。
**也可以直接联系中文机构**：华人策划协会法拉盛 718-358-8899、民权中心法拉盛 718-460-5600、华人进步会（曼哈顿华埠）212-274-1891。
**见律师时带齐**：护照、绿卡或其他身份证件、所有移民局和法庭的信件（连信封）、以前递交过的表格副本。
**付钱之前**：确认对方是**律师或司法部认可的代表**，要求英文和中文的书面合同，写清楚收费和服务内容；原件自己保管，只给复印件。
en: **Call a free hotline first**: the NYS New Americans Hotline **1-800-566-7636** (Mon–Fri 8am–8pm, weekends 9am–5pm; anonymous; 200+ languages), or the NYC Immigration Legal Support Hotline **800-354-0365** (or call 311 and say "Immigration Legal"). When connected, say "Chinese, please".
NYC hotline hours: Mon and Wed 9am–8pm; Tue, Thu and Fri 9am–6pm; last Saturday of the month 9am–5pm.
**Before calling, prepare**: write down your question, your status, and any USCIS or court letters you got, with their dates and deadlines. Keep a pen and paper ready.

**Tell the hotline clearly**: your borough, what you need (citizenship, green card, a court notice, etc.) and any urgent deadline. They'll tell you where to find **City-funded, free and safe** legal help.
**For citizenship or green card help**: call **311** and say "ActionNYC" to get free assistance.

**You can also contact Chinese-language groups directly**: Chinese-American Planning Council, Flushing 718-358-8899; MinKwon Center, Flushing 718-460-5600; Chinese Progressive Association (Manhattan Chinatown) 212-274-1891.
**Bring to the lawyer**: passport, green card or other ID, every USCIS and court letter (with envelopes), and copies of forms you filed before.

**Before paying anyone**: make sure they are a **lawyer or DOJ-accredited representative**, get a written contract in English and Chinese stating fees and services, and keep your originals, giving only copies.

label.zh: 纽约州新美国人热线（免费、匿名、200多种语言）
label.en: NYS New Americans Hotline (free, anonymous, 200+ languages)

label.zh: 纽约市移民法律支援热线
ActionNYC 免费入籍和绿卡协助
民权中心 MinKwon Center，法拉盛
华人进步会（曼哈顿华埠，粤语/普通话）
举报移民诈骗：纽约州检察长热线
label.en: Report immigration fraud: NY Attorney General

zh: “公证人能办移民”：公证人不是律师，只能填表和翻译
“保证批准”：任何保证结果、说有内部关系的都是警讯
“先签空白表格”：绝对不要签空白或内容不实的表格
en: "A notario can handle my case": notaries aren't lawyers and may only fill forms and translate
"Guaranteed approval": promises or "inside connections" are red flags
"Just sign the blank form": never sign blank or false forms

sources.name: 纽约州新美国人热线公告
纽约市移民事务办公室：法律支援热线
纽约州检察长：移民服务诈骗
纽约市移民法律支援热线
纽约州新美国人办公室

zh: **热线不直接代理案子**：纽约市热线不提供法律服务、也不帮你约时间，会告诉你去哪里找可信的机构；不一定能马上安排审核，也**不保证**有人接下你的全部案子。
**被转介后**：尽快按转介打电话或预约。机构会先问你的情况和收入，看能不能帮你。
**一家没空就换一家**：继续问其他热线和中文机构，特别是你的信上有期限的时候。
en: **The hotlines don't take your case themselves**: the NYC hotline doesn't provide legal services or book appointments; it points you to trusted providers. A screening isn't guaranteed right away, and **no one guarantees** full representation.
**After a referral**: call or book as soon as possible. The organization will ask about your situation and income to see if they can help.
**If one place is full, try another**: keep calling other hotlines and Chinese-language groups, especially if your letter has a deadline.
**If you're scammed**: report it to the NY Attorney General at **1-800-771-7755**, or to the New Americans Hotline at 1-800-566-7636.

zh: **公证人（notario）不是律师**，只能帮你填表和翻译，不能给你法律意见。
说“保证批准”“有内部关系”“先签空白表格”的，都是警讯，马上离开。
任何时候都**不要把原件交给别人保管**，只给复印件。
移民局的信有期限，收到看不懂，当天就打热线，不要等。
en: **A notary ("notario") is not a lawyer**; they may only fill forms and translate, not give legal advice.
"Guaranteed approval", "inside connections" or "just sign this blank form" are red flags; walk away.
**Never hand over your original documents** for someone to keep; give copies only.
USCIS letters have deadlines. If you can't read one, call a hotline that same day.

title.zh: 白卡（纽约州 Medicaid）

short.zh: 低收入免费医疗保险；2026年10月起对移民规定有变
short.en: Free health coverage for low income; rules for immigrants changed Oct 2026

summary.zh: 白卡（Medicaid）是给低收入人士的免费医疗保险，看病、住院、买药基本不用自己付钱。19–64 岁成人的收入标准是联邦贫困线的 **138%**，单人每月约 **$1,836**。2025 年通过的联邦新法案从 2026 年起陆续改了不少规定，下面先看“最新变化”。
summary.en: Medicaid is free health coverage for people with low income: doctor visits, hospital care and prescriptions with little or no cost. Adults 19–64 qualify up to **138% of the poverty line**, about **$1,836 a month** for one person. A 2025 federal law changed several rules; see "What changed recently" first.

zh: **2026 年 10 月 1 日起**，难民、庇护者、假释入境者等不再享有联邦白卡；纽约州表示会把他们转到 Essential Plan，福利不变。儿童和孕妇不受影响。
**2027 年 1 月 1 日起**，19–64 岁的扩展白卡成人需要每月工作、上学、培训或做义工满 **80 小时**（或月收入至少 $580），并改为**每 6 个月续一次**。65 岁以上、孕妇、残障、照顾 14 岁以下孩子等人豁免。
**小提示**：在 **2027 年 1 月 1 日前申请**、或在 **2027 年 3 月 1 日前续期**的人，会先获得 12 个月保障。
en: **From Oct 1, 2026**, refugees, asylees, parolees and some others lost federally funded Medicaid; New York says they move to the Essential Plan with the same benefits. Children and pregnant people are not affected.

**From Jan 1, 2027**, expansion adults 19–64 must work, study, train or volunteer **80 hours a month** (or earn at least $580) and renew **every 6 months**. People 65+, pregnant, disabled, caring for a child under 14 and others are exempt.
**Tip**: people who **apply before January 1, 2027** or **renew before March 1, 2027** get 12 months of coverage first.

zh: 65 岁以上、失明或残障：单人月收入 $1,836、两人 $2,489 以下，资产单人 $33,038、两人 $44,796 以下
**身份**：公民、满 5 年的绿卡持有人、古巴/海地入境者等可获联邦白卡
**没有身份的 65 岁以上长者、孕妇（含产后 12 个月内）和儿童**，纽约州用州政府资金提供白卡或儿童保险。注意：2026 年 10 月 31 日起，在护理院住满 3 个月以上的无身份 65 岁以上长者改为只保紧急医疗
DACA、PRUCOL 等身份按收入可获州资助白卡；绿卡未满 5 年的，可能由州资金覆盖，申请时请确认
其他没有身份的成人，符合收入和居住条件的可申请**紧急白卡**（急诊）
en: 65+, blind or disabled: income up to $1,836 (1) or $2,489 (2) a month; assets up to $33,038 (1) or $44,796 (2)
**Status**: citizens, green card holders past the 5-year wait, Cuban/Haitian entrants and some others get federal Medicaid

**Undocumented people 65+, pregnant people (up to 12 months after birth) and children** get state-funded coverage in New York. Note: from Oct 31, 2026, undocumented people 65+ in a nursing home for 3+ months are limited to emergency coverage
DACA and PRUCOL may get state-funded Medicaid based on income; green card holders under 5 years may be covered by state funds, so ask when you apply
Other undocumented adults who meet income and residency rules can get **Emergency Medicaid**

zh: **先看你走哪条路**：65 岁以下（包括孕妇、孩子、19–64 岁成人）向 **NY State of Health**（纽约州官方医保市场）申请；纽约市 65 岁以上、因残障或失明申请、或有 Medicare 而且没有未成年孩子的人，向 **HRA**（纽约市人力资源管理局）申请。纽约市以外的长者，向所在县的社会服务局（DSS）申请。
**准备资料**：每个家人的出生日期、社安号（SSN）或移民文件号码、工作和收入情况、现有保险情况。再准备身份证明、收入证明（如最近 4 周工资单）、住址证明的复印件。65 岁以上还要准备银行等资产证明。
**65 岁以下——网上申请**：上 nystateofhealth.ny.gov，建立账户，按提示填写申请，最后提交。不会用电脑可以跳过这一步，用下面的电话或协助员。
**65 岁以下——电话申请**：打 **1-855-355-5777**（周一至周五早 8 点到晚 8 点，周六早 9 点到下午 1 点）。听到英文录音后说 “**Chinese, Mandarin please**” 或 “**Cantonese please**”，要求免费中文翻译，请工作人员帮你在电话里填申请。
**65 岁以下——找人当面帮你**：在 NY State of Health 网站找 “Find Local Help”，找附近的**协助员**（assistor，经过培训的免费帮手）。他们在社区机构和医院，会讲多种语言，平日、晚上和周末都有，**全部免费**。

**纽约市 65 岁以上——找 HRA**：可以网上用 ACCESS HRA 申请；或打 HRA 热线 **888-692-6116** 要一份申请表寄到家；或亲自去 HRA 医疗保险办公室（Medicaid Office）。华人常去的**华埠办公室**：115 Chrystie Street 5 楼，电话 212-274-4719，周一至周五 9 点到 5 点。其他办公室地址在 HRA 网站上。
**纽约市 65 岁以上——邮寄或传真**：填好表后寄到 Initial Eligibility Unit, HRA/Medical Assistance Program, PO Box 24390, Brooklyn, NY 11202，或传真到 917-639-0732。只寄**复印件**，原件自己留着。
**不用面谈**：申请白卡**不需要面谈**（interview），寄表或交表就可以。你也可以主动去办公室或打电话请人帮你填表。
**提交后马上记录**：写下申请日期、你的账户号码（NY State of Health 的账户号码以 “AC” 开头），拍照或复印你交出去的所有文件。
en: **First, find your route**: under 65 (including pregnant people, children and adults 19–64) apply through **NY State of Health** (New York's official health marketplace). In NYC, people 65+, people applying because of disability or blindness, and people on Medicare without minor children apply through **HRA** (NYC Human Resources Administration). Seniors outside NYC apply at their county Department of Social Services (DSS).

**Get your information ready**: each family member's birth date, Social Security number (SSN) or immigration document number, job and income details, and current insurance. Also have copies of ID, proof of income (such as the last 4 weeks of pay stubs) and proof of address. If you are 65+, also bring proof of assets such as bank statements.
**Under 65 – apply online**: go to nystateofhealth.ny.gov, create an account, follow the steps and submit. If you don't use a computer, skip this and use the phone or a helper below.

**Under 65 – apply by phone**: call **1-855-355-5777** (Mon–Fri 8am–8pm, Sat 9am–1pm). After the English recording, say "**Chinese, Mandarin please**" or "**Cantonese please**" to get a free interpreter, and ask the worker to fill out the application with you on the phone.

**Under 65 – get in-person help**: on the NY State of Health website, use "Find Local Help" to find an **assistor** (a trained, free helper) near you. They work at community groups and hospitals, speak many languages, have weekday, evening and weekend hours, and **all help is free**.

**NYC, 65+ – go through HRA**: apply online with ACCESS HRA; or call the HRA Helpline at **888-692-6116** to get an application mailed to you; or go in person to an HRA Medicaid Office. The **Chinatown office** is at 115 Chrystie Street, 5th Floor, phone 212-274-4719, Mon–Fri 9am–5pm. Other office addresses are on the HRA website.

**NYC, 65+ – mail or fax**: send the completed form to Initial Eligibility Unit, HRA/Medical Assistance Program, PO Box 24390, Brooklyn, NY 11202, or fax it to 917-639-0732. Send **copies** only and keep the originals.
**No interview needed**: Medicaid **does not require an interview**. You can just mail or drop off the form. You can still go to an office or call if you want someone to help you fill it out.
**Write things down right away**: note the date you applied and your account number (NY State of Health account numbers start with "AC"), and photograph or copy every document you hand in.

“领白卡会影响绿卡”：2026 年 9 月起公共负担规定有变，正在申请或准备申请绿卡的人请先看《公共负担》指南并咨询免费律师

"Approved once, covered forever": you must renew; adults every 6 months from 2027

zh: **多久有结果**：你会收到书面通知（notice），告诉你批准、拒绝或要补交什么。向 HRA 或县社会服务局申请的，一般应在 **45 天内**决定；孕妇和 19 岁以下孩子 **30 天内**；需要审核残障的，最长 **90 天**。
**要补材料**：如果通知说缺材料，要在通知写的期限前交上（至少会给你 10 天）。NY State of Health 的可以登录账户上传，或用手机 App “**NYSOH Mobile Upload**” 拍照上传，也可以找协助员帮你。
**批准之后**：大多数人要选一家保险公司的计划（health plan）。选之前可以用纽约州的 “Provider & Health Plan Look-Up” 查你的医生在不在这个计划里。之后要用计划里的医生看病。
**被拒绝或被减少怎么办**：NY State of Health 的决定，从通知日期起 **60 天内**可以申请上诉（appeal），打 1-855-355-5777、邮寄或传真到 1-855-900-5557 都可以。HRA 或县社会服务局的决定，**60 天内**申请公平听证（fair hearing），打通知上写的电话，或打州政府听证热线 1-800-342-3334。
**想在上诉期间不断保**：如果你本来有白卡、现在要被停掉或减少，要在**通知写的生效日期之前**（或通知晚到时，在寄出日期后 **10 天内**）申请上诉，并要求“**继续保留福利**”（aid continuing）。
**续保**（renewal，定期重新确认资格）：快到期时会收到信、短信或电邮。网上登录后点 “Update Application”，或打电话、找协助员办理。2027 年 1 月 1 日起，19–64 岁成人大多改为**每 6 个月**续一次。如果没续上被停保，**90 天内**补交资料还可以申请恢复。
en: **How long it takes**: you will get a written notice saying you are approved, denied, or need to send more papers. If you applied through HRA or your county DSS, a decision is generally due within **45 days**; within **30 days** for pregnant people and children under 19; up to **90 days** if a disability review is needed.

**If they ask for more papers**: send them by the deadline in the notice (you get at least 10 days). With NY State of Health, you can log in and upload them, use the phone app "**NYSOH Mobile Upload**" to take a photo, or ask an assistor to help.

**After you are approved**: most people need to pick a health plan from an insurance company. Before you choose, use New York's "Provider & Health Plan Look-Up" to check whether your doctor is in the plan. After that, you see doctors in your plan.

**If you are denied or your coverage is cut**: for a NY State of Health decision, you can appeal within **60 days** of the notice date by calling 1-855-355-5777, by mail, or by fax to 1-855-900-5557. For an HRA or county DSS decision, ask for a fair hearing within **60 days**, using the phone number on your notice or the state hearing line at 1-800-342-3334.

**To keep coverage during an appeal**: if you already have Medicaid and it is being stopped or cut, appeal **before the effective date** on the notice (or within **10 days** of the mailing date if the notice came late) and ask to **keep your benefits** ("aid continuing").

**Renewal** (checking again that you still qualify): before it is due you will get a letter, text or email. Log in and click "Update Application", or call or see an assistor. From January 1, 2027, most adults 19–64 renew **every 6 months**. If your coverage ends because you missed it, you have **90 days** to send the information and ask to have it restored.

zh: **申请前 3 个月的医药费单据要留着**：批准后可能可以报销（2027 年起，19–64 岁成人只追溯 1 个月，其他人 2 个月）。所以觉得自己符合就**尽早申请**。
**所有官方来信都要拆开看**，看不懂就拿给协助员或打热线问。很多人断保只是因为没回信。
**地址、电话换了马上更新**：NY State of Health 的可以网上登录、打电话或找协助员改；通过 HRA 或县社会服务局申请的，要联系他们改。
**申请完全免费**。不要付钱给任何人“代办”，也不要把社安号、账户密码交给陌生人。
想收到截止日期提醒，可以发短信 **START** 到 **1-866-988-0327**（NY State of Health 的提醒短信）。
en: **Keep medical bills from the 3 months before you apply**: once approved, they may be paid back (from 2027, adults 19–64 get only 1 month back and others 2 months). So if you think you qualify, **apply early**.
**Open every official letter.** If you can't read it, show it to an assistor or call the helpline. Many people lose coverage only because they didn't answer a letter.
**Update your address and phone right away**: for NY State of Health, log in, call, or see an assistor; if you applied through HRA or your county DSS, contact them.
**Applying is completely free.** Don't pay anyone to apply for you, and never give your Social Security number or account password to strangers.
To get deadline reminders, text **START** to **1-866-988-0327** (NY State of Health text alerts).

title.zh: Essential Plan 基本医疗计划

short.zh: 收入略高于白卡标准的成人，保费 $0
short.en: $0 premium coverage for adults just above Medicaid income

summary.zh: Essential Plan 是纽约州给 19–64 岁、收入在联邦贫困线 **200% 以下**但不符合白卡的人的医疗保险，**保费 $0**。单人年收入约 **$31,920** 以下。
summary.en: The Essential Plan covers adults 19–64 with income up to **200% of the poverty line** who don't qualify for Medicaid, with a **$0 premium**. That's about **$31,920 a year** for one person.

zh: **2026 年 7 月 1 日起**，收入在贫困线 200–250% 的约 45 万人离开 Essential Plan，转到市场上的保险计划（QHP）。
**2026 年 10 月起**，失去联邦白卡的难民、庇护者等转到 Essential Plan，福利不变。
部分 DACA 人士可能失去保障，请尽快联络 NY State of Health 或免费的保险协助员。
**2027 年起**，联邦资金只覆盖绿卡持有人、古巴/海地入境者和自由联合国家公民；收入超过贫困线 138% 的其他合法移民可能失去 Essential Plan。纽约州表示计划用州资金补上，细节尚未确定。
en: **Since July 1, 2026**, about 450,000 people at 200–250% of poverty moved from the Essential Plan to marketplace plans (QHPs).
**Since October 2026**, refugees and asylees who lost federal Medicaid move to the Essential Plan with the same benefits.
Some DACA recipients may lose coverage; contact NY State of Health or a free navigator soon.

**From 2027**, federal funding covers only green card holders, Cuban/Haitian entrants and COFA citizens; other lawfully present immigrants above 138% of poverty may lose the Essential Plan. New York says it plans to use state funds, but details aren't final.

zh: 收入在联邦贫困线 200% 以内，且不符合白卡
合法居留的移民（目前包括绿卡、难民、庇护等；2027 年起可能改变，见上方）
**没有身份的成人不符合**（可看《NYC Care》）
en: Ages 19–64
Income up to 200% of poverty and not Medicaid-eligible
Lawfully present immigrants (currently including green card holders, refugees and asylees; this may change in 2027, see above)
**Undocumented adults are not eligible** (see NYC Care)

zh: **先估一下收入**：2026 年，家庭年收入在这些数字以下可以考虑 Essential Plan：1 人 $31,920、2 人 $43,280、3 人 $54,640、4 人 $66,000。收入更低的，系统可能会直接判你符合白卡。
**准备资料**：每个家人的出生日期、社安号（SSN）或移民文件号码（如绿卡号码）、工作和收入情况、有没有雇主保险。
**网上申请**：上 nystateofhealth.ny.gov，建立账户，填写申请，提交。同一份申请会一起看你适合白卡、Essential Plan 还是别的计划。
**电话申请**：打 **1-855-355-5777**（周一至周五早 8 点到晚 8 点，周六早 9 点到下午 1 点）。说 “**Chinese, Mandarin please**” 或 “**Cantonese please**”，要免费中文翻译，请工作人员帮你填。
**找人当面帮**：在网站上点 “Find Local Help” 找附近的**协助员**（assistor）或经纪人（broker），**免费**，会讲多种语言。
**全年都可以申请**，不用等开放期（Open Enrollment）。
**选计划**：符合资格后，要选一家保险公司的计划。可以用 “Plans by County” 看你住的县有哪些计划，用 “Provider & Health Plan Look-Up” 查你的医生在不在里面。保费是 **$0**，年度自付额（deductible）也是 $0。
**提交后记下**：申请日期和账户号码（以 “AC” 开头），保存所有通知。
en: **Check your income first**: in 2026 you may qualify if yearly household income is under: 1 person $31,920, 2 people $43,280, 3 people $54,640, 4 people $66,000. If your income is lower, the system may find you eligible for Medicaid instead.

**Get your information ready**: each family member's birth date, Social Security number (SSN) or immigration document number (such as a green card number), job and income details, and whether you have job-based insurance.
**Apply online**: go to nystateofhealth.ny.gov, create an account, fill out the application and submit. One application checks you for Medicaid, the Essential Plan and other plans at the same time.

**Apply by phone**: call **1-855-355-5777** (Mon–Fri 8am–8pm, Sat 9am–1pm). Say "**Chinese, Mandarin please**" or "**Cantonese please**" for a free interpreter and ask the worker to fill it out with you.
**Get in-person help**: on the website, click "Find Local Help" to find an **assistor** or broker near you. It's **free** and they speak many languages.
**You can apply any time of year**; you don't have to wait for Open Enrollment.

**Pick a plan**: once you qualify, choose a plan from an insurance company. Use "Plans by County" to see plans where you live and "Provider & Health Plan Look-Up" to check if your doctor is in it. The premium is **$0** and the yearly deductible is $0.
**After you submit, write down** the date and your account number (it starts with "AC"), and keep every notice.

zh: **结果通知**：你会收到通知，也会放在你的网上账户里，告诉你符合哪个计划，或要补交什么材料。
**补交材料**：按通知上的期限交。可以登录账户上传，或用手机 App “**NYSOH Mobile Upload**” 拍照上传，或找协助员帮忙。

**被拒绝怎么办**：从通知日期起 **60 天内**可以上诉（appeal）。打 1-855-355-5777，或邮寄到 NY State of Health, Appeals Unit, P.O. Box 11729, Albany, NY 12211，或传真 1-855-900-5557，或登录账户上传上诉表（DOH-5231）。上诉时可以同时要求**继续保留现有保险**。一般上诉大约 **90 天**有结果；病情紧急的可以附医生信要求加快。
**收入或家庭有变化**：要主动更新，网上登录、打电话或找协助员都可以。
**续保**：快到期会收到信、短信或电邮。登录后点 “Update Application”，或打电话、找协助员办理。没收到通知也要留意自己的到期日（登录后在 “Plans” 一栏可以看到）。
en: **Your result**: you get a notice, also posted in your online account, telling you which program you qualify for or what papers to send.
**Sending papers**: send them by the deadline on the notice. Log in and upload them, use the phone app "**NYSOH Mobile Upload**" to take a photo, or ask an assistor.

**If you are denied**: you can appeal within **60 days** of the notice date. Call 1-855-355-5777, mail NY State of Health, Appeals Unit, P.O. Box 11729, Albany, NY 12211, fax 1-855-900-5557, or upload the appeal form (DOH-5231) in your account. When you appeal you can also ask to **keep your current coverage**. A regular appeal takes about **90 days**; if your health can't wait, include a doctor's note and ask for a fast-track appeal.
**If your income or family changes**: update it yourself online, by phone, or with an assistor.

**Renewal**: before it is due you'll get a letter, text or email. Log in and click "Update Application", or call or see an assistor. Even without a notice, watch your end date (log in and look under the "Plans" tab).

zh: **移民身份规定 2026–2027 年变化很多**（见上方“最新变化”），收到任何关于身份的信，马上找协助员或打热线问清楚。
**申请完全免费**，不要付钱给任何人代办。
**把每封通知拍照存起来**，并写下账户号码（AC 开头），打电话时会用到。
想收到截止日期提醒，发短信 **START** 到 **1-866-988-0327**。
en: **Immigration rules are changing a lot in 2026–2027** (see "What changed recently" above). If you get any letter about your status, ask an assistor or call the helpline right away.
**Applying is completely free.** Don't pay anyone to apply for you.
**Take a photo of every notice** and write down your account number (starts with "AC"); you'll need it when you call.
For deadline reminders, text **START** to **1-866-988-0327**.

title.zh: 儿童医疗保险（Child Health Plus）

short.zh: 19岁以下孩子不论身份都能投保，很多家庭免费
short.en: Coverage for kids under 19 regardless of status; free for many families

summary.zh: 纽约州 19 岁以下的孩子，**不论移民身份**，只要不符合白卡又没有其他保险，就能参加 Child Health Plus。收入较低的家庭**免费**，较高的每个孩子每月 $15 起，**没有自付额**，全年都能申请。
summary.en: Children under 19 in New York, **regardless of immigration status**, can join Child Health Plus if they don't qualify for Medicaid and have no other insurance. Lower-income families pay **nothing**; others pay from $15 per child a month, with **no copays**. Enroll any time.

zh: 19 岁以下、住在纽约州
不符合白卡、没有其他保险
不问移民身份
免费标准举例：2 人家庭年收入约 $46,953 以下（每月约 $3,913）；超过的按收入分级付保费，每个孩子每月 $15 起，每家最多付 3 个孩子（以官方最新表格为准）
en: Under 19 and living in New York
Not Medicaid-eligible, no other insurance
Any immigration status
Free example: a household of 2 up to about $46,953 a year (about $3,913 a month); above that, premiums by income from $15 per child a month, for at most 3 children (check the current official chart)

zh: **孩子没有身份也可以申请**。19 岁以下、住在纽约州、没有其他保险就可以。
**准备资料**：家里每个人的出生日期、社安号（SSN）或移民文件号码（**没有的可以不填**）、工作和收入情况、现有保险情况。
**统一在 NY State of Health 申请**：保险公司已经**不收**纸本、传真或电邮申请，都要通过 NY State of Health。
**网上申请**：上 nystateofhealth.ny.gov，建立账户，填写孩子的资料，提交。系统会同时看孩子适合儿童白卡还是 Child Health Plus。
**电话申请**：打 **1-855-355-5777**（周一至周五早 8 点到晚 8 点，周六早 9 点到下午 1 点），说 “**Chinese, Mandarin please**” 或 “**Cantonese please**”，要免费中文翻译。
**找人当面帮**：在网站点 “Find Local Help” 找**协助员**（assistor），医院、社区机构和保险公司都有，**免费**。
**有问题也可以打州卫生厅儿童保险热线**：1-800-698-4543（1-800-698-4KIDS），问 Child Health Plus 和儿童白卡的问题。
**选计划**：符合资格后要选一家保险公司的计划。用 “Plans by County” 看你住的县有哪些计划，用 “Provider & Health Plan Look-Up” 查孩子的医生在不在里面。
**全年都可以申请**，不用等。
en: **Children can apply even without immigration status.** Any child under 19 who lives in New York and has no other insurance can apply.

**Get your information ready**: each household member's birth date, Social Security number (SSN) or immigration document number (**leave it blank if you don't have one**), job and income details, and current insurance.
**Apply only through NY State of Health**: health plans **no longer accept** paper, fax or email applications.
**Apply online**: go to nystateofhealth.ny.gov, create an account, enter your child's information and submit. The system checks your child for both children's Medicaid and Child Health Plus.
**Apply by phone**: call **1-855-355-5777** (Mon–Fri 8am–8pm, Sat 9am–1pm) and say "**Chinese, Mandarin please**" or "**Cantonese please**" for a free interpreter.
**Get in-person help**: click "Find Local Help" on the website to find an **assistor** at a hospital, community group or health plan. It's **free**.
**For questions, you can also call the state children's health line**: 1-800-698-4543 (1-800-698-4KIDS), for Child Health Plus and children's Medicaid.

**Pick a plan**: once eligible, choose a plan from an insurance company. Use "Plans by County" to see plans where you live and "Provider & Health Plan Look-Up" to check if your child's doctor is in it.
**You can apply any time of year.**

en: **Your result**: you get a notice, also posted in your online account, saying which program your child qualifies for, whether there is a monthly premium, or what papers to send.
**Sending papers**: send them by the deadline on the notice. Log in to upload, or use the phone app "**NYSOH Mobile Upload**" to take a photo.
**Premiums**: lower-income families **pay nothing**; other families pay $15, $30, $45 or $60 per child a month by income, for at most 3 children. There are **no copays** for care.

**If you disagree**: you can appeal within **60 days** of the notice date. Call 1-855-355-5777, mail NY State of Health, Appeals Unit, P.O. Box 11729, Albany, NY 12211, or fax 1-855-900-5557. When you appeal you can ask to **keep your current coverage**.

zh: **给孩子申请不会问家长的移民身份**，不要因为担心身份而不给孩子买保险。
**收入有变化要主动更新**，收入降低了，保费可能会减少甚至免费。
**申请完全免费**，不要付钱给任何人代办。
**保存每封通知**，写下账户号码（AC 开头）。
en: **Child Health Plus does not depend on immigration status.** Don't skip coverage for your child because you worry about status.
**Update your income when it changes**; if it goes down, your premium may go down or become free.
**Applying is completely free.** Don't pay anyone to apply for you.
**Keep every notice** and write down your account number (starts with "AC").

title.zh: NYC Care 纽约市医疗服务计划

short.zh: 没有保险、也买不到保险的人，不问身份看病
short.en: Care for people who can't get insurance, regardless of status

summary.zh: NYC Care 不是保险，而是纽约市公立医院（NYC Health + Hospitals）的**看病计划**，给不符合任何保险的人。**不问移民身份**，按收入浮动收费，可以低到 **$0**，有自己的家庭医生。
summary.en: NYC Care is not insurance; it's a care program at NYC Health + Hospitals for people who can't get any health plan. **Status isn't asked**, costs slide by income starting at **$0**, and you get your own primary care doctor.

zh: 住在纽约市五大区
不符合纽约州任何医疗保险，也没有雇主保险
不问移民身份
en: Lives in the five boroughs
Not eligible for any NY health plan and no job-based insurance
Immigration status isn't asked

zh: **先确认你适合**：住在纽约市五大区，没有雇主保险，也不符合纽约州任何医疗保险。**不问移民身份**。
**准备身份证明**（任选一种）：驾照或非驾驶身份证、**IDNYC 市民卡**、护照、绿卡、工卡或出生证明。
**准备收入证明**（任选一种）：最近 4 周的工资单、雇主信，或退休金、SSI、失业金的批准信或支票。
**准备住址证明**（任选一种）：有邮戳的信封、最近 90 天的水电煤账单、租约或房贷账单。如果你之前已经在 NY State of Health 查过保险资格，把结果也带上。
**缺资料也先去**：资料不齐，NYC Care 也可能帮你登记。

**选一种方式登记**：① 打 **646-NYC-CARE（646-692-2273）**，说 “**Chinese, Mandarin please**” 或 “**Cantonese please**”；② 去任何一家 NYC Health + Hospitals 公立医院找**财务顾问**（financial counselor）；③ 去 MetroPlusHealth 办公室；④ 去 NYC Care 合作的社区机构。
**电话登记的**：资料可以上传到 **MyChart**（公立医院的病人网上系统），或在看病时带去。
**已经是公立医院病人的**：如果过去 6 个月内已经做过保险资格检查，可能可以**快速登记**，打电话或到场时问一下。
en: **Check that it fits you**: you live in the five boroughs, have no job-based insurance, and don't qualify for any New York State health plan. **Immigration status isn't asked.**
**Bring proof of identity** (any one): driver's license or non-driver ID, **IDNYC**, passport, green card, work permit or birth certificate.
**Bring proof of income** (any one): pay stubs from the last 4 weeks, an employer letter, or an award letter or check for pension, SSI or unemployment.

**Bring proof of address** (any one): a postmarked envelope, a utility bill from the last 90 days, a lease or a mortgage statement. If you were already screened by NY State of Health, bring that result too.
**Go even if you're missing papers**: NYC Care may still be able to enroll you.

**Choose how to enroll**: (1) call **646-NYC-CARE (646-692-2273)** and say "**Chinese, Mandarin please**" or "**Cantonese please**"; (2) see a **financial counselor** at any NYC Health + Hospitals location; (3) visit a MetroPlusHealth office; or (4) visit an NYC Care community partner.
**If you enroll by phone**: upload your papers to **MyChart** (the public hospitals' online patient portal), or bring them to your appointment.
**If you're already a public-hospital patient**: if you were screened for insurance in the last 6 months, you may get **fast-track enrollment**; ask when you call or visit.

zh: **会员卡寄到家**：卡上写着你看病要付多少钱，以及有效期（effective through）。每次看病都要带着。
**第一次看病**：ACCESS NYC 说，登记后一般 **两周内**可以约到第一次门诊，你会有自己的家庭医生。
**费用**：按收入和家庭人数收费，**最低 $0**，没有会员费、月费或保费。
**每 12 个月续一次**：财务顾问会再帮你查一次有没有资格买保险。可以在卡到期前 **30 天**内办理，带上当初登记用的资料。
**语言**：公立医院有 **250 多种语言**的免费翻译，当面或电话都可以，书面材料也可以翻译。
en: **Your card comes in the mail**: it shows what you pay for care and the date it expires ("effective through"). Bring it every time you get care.
**Your first visit**: ACCESS NYC says you should get your first appointment within **two weeks**, with your own primary care doctor.
**Costs**: based on income and family size, **starting at $0**, with no membership fee, monthly fee or premium.
**Renew every 12 months**: a financial counselor checks again whether you qualify for insurance. You can renew up to **30 days** before your card expires; bring the papers you used to enroll.
**Language**: the public hospitals offer free interpreters in **more than 250 languages and dialects**, in person or by phone, plus written translations.

zh: **NYC Care 说你的资料不会交给移民官员**，可以放心登记。
**NYC Care 只在 NYC Health + Hospitals 公立医院和诊所用**，去私立医院或诊所不算。
**记下卡上的到期日**，提前 30 天去续，免得中断。
**登记免费**，不要付钱给任何人代办。
en: **NYC Care says your information is not shared with immigration officials**, so you can enroll safely.
**NYC Care works only at NYC Health + Hospitals locations**, not at private hospitals or clinics.
**Write down the expiration date on your card** and renew 30 days early so care isn't interrupted.
**Enrollment is free.** Don't pay anyone to enroll you.

title.zh: 红蓝卡（Medicare）省钱方案：MSP、EPIC、Extra Help
title.en: Help with Medicare costs: MSP, EPIC, Extra Help

short.zh: 65岁以上：帮付 Medicare 保费和药费
short.en: 65+: help paying Medicare premiums and drug costs

summary.zh: 有红蓝卡的长者，收入不高的话可以申请三种帮助：**Medicare 储蓄计划（MSP）**帮你付每月保费，**EPIC** 是纽约州的老人药费补助，**Extra Help** 帮付处方药费用。
summary.en: Seniors on Medicare with modest income can get three kinds of help: the **Medicare Savings Program (MSP)** pays monthly premiums, **EPIC** is New York's senior drug program, and **Extra Help** lowers prescription costs.

zh: 联邦新法规定，难民、庇护者、TPS 等身份将失去 Medicare（绿卡满 5 年者不受影响），社安退休金不变。具体时间表尚未最终确定，收到社安局信件请尽快找免费律师。
en: Under the new federal law, refugees, asylees, TPS holders and some others will lose Medicare (green card holders past 5 years are not affected); Social Security checks don't change. The timeline isn't final; if you get a letter from SSA, see a free lawyer soon.

zh: MSP：单人月收入约 $2,474、两人 $3,355 以下（2026 年），**纽约没有资产限制**
EPIC：65 岁以上并有 Part D 药物计划；单身年收入 $75,000、夫妇 $100,000 以下
Extra Help：单人月收入约 $2,015、夫妇约 $2,725 以下，资产单人 $18,090、夫妇 $36,100 以下
en: MSP: monthly income up to about $2,474 (1) or $3,355 (2) in 2026; **New York has no asset test**
EPIC: 65+ with a Part D plan; income up to $75,000 single or $100,000 married
Extra Help: income up to about $2,015 (single) or $2,725 (couple) a month; assets up to $18,090 or $36,100

zh: **MSP（Medicare 储蓄计划）——拿表**：用纽约州表格 **DOH-4328**（有中文填表说明）。纽约市的人可以打 HRA 热线 **888-692-6116** 要表，或到 HRA 医疗保险办公室拿，如华埠办公室：115 Chrystie Street 5 楼。
**MSP——附上复印件**：红蓝卡正反面、出生日期证明（如护照、绿卡）、住址证明（6 个月内的租约、水电账单或有邮戳的信封，不能是邮政信箱）、收入证明（如社安金或退休金的通知信）、非公民的移民文件。夫妻一起申请的，配偶也要。**纽约 MSP 不查资产**，不用交银行证明。
**MSP——交表**：纽约市寄给或送到 HRA；纽约市以外交给县社会服务局（DSS）。寄出前把整份申请复印一份留着。
**Extra Help（处方药补助）——先看是否自动有**：已经有全额白卡、MSP 或 SSI 的人，会**自动**得到 Extra Help，不用另外申请。
**Extra Help——申请**：上社安局网站 ssa.gov/extrahelp 网上申请；或打社安局 **1-800-772-1213**（周一至周五早 8 点到晚 7 点），要求预约申请 Extra Help。打电话时**听到英文录音不要出声，等真人接听**，再说 “**Chinese, Mandarin please**”，社安局会免费找翻译。
**Extra Help——准备**：你和配偶的银行月结单、报税表、退休金、IRA/401(k) 结余、年金等资料。
**EPIC（纽约州老人药费补助）——拿表**：打 EPIC 热线 **1-800-332-3742**（周一至周五早 8 点到下午 5 点）要申请表，有**简体中文**表格；也可以在 EPIC 网站上网上申请。全年都可以申请。
**EPIC——填表寄回**：按表上的地址寄回或传真。**不用附任何文件**，EPIC 会自己向社安局和纽约州税务局核对你的收入。记住：要有或能参加 Medicare Part D 药物计划才能用 EPIC。
**不会填表就找免费顾问**：打纽约州 **HIICAP** 热线 **1-800-701-0501**，说出你住的区，会转给当地的免费 Medicare 顾问。
en: **MSP (Medicare Savings Program) – get the form**: use New York form **DOH-4328** (Chinese instructions are available). In NYC, call the HRA Helpline at **888-692-6116** for a form, or pick one up at an HRA Medicaid Office, such as the Chinatown office at 115 Chrystie Street, 5th Floor.

**MSP – attach copies**: front and back of your Medicare card, proof of birth date (such as a passport or green card), proof of address (lease, utility bill or postmarked envelope from the last 6 months, not a P.O. Box), proof of income (such as a Social Security or pension letter), and immigration papers if you're not a citizen. If your spouse applies too, include theirs. **New York's MSP has no asset test**, so no bank statements are needed.
**MSP – hand it in**: in NYC, mail or bring it to HRA; outside NYC, to your county Department of Social Services (DSS). Make a copy of the whole application before you send it.
**Extra Help (drug cost help) – check if you already have it**: people with full Medicaid, MSP or SSI get Extra Help **automatically** and don't need to apply.

**Extra Help – apply**: apply online at ssa.gov/extrahelp, or call Social Security at **1-800-772-1213** (Mon–Fri 8am–7pm) and ask for an appointment to apply for Extra Help. When you call, **stay silent during the English recording until a person answers**, then say "**Chinese, Mandarin please**"; Social Security will get a free interpreter.
**Extra Help – have ready**: bank statements, tax returns, and pension, IRA/401(k) and annuity statements for you and your spouse.

**EPIC (New York's senior drug program) – get the form**: call the EPIC Helpline at **1-800-332-3742** (Mon–Fri 8am–5pm) for an application; a **Simplified Chinese** form is available. You can also apply online from the EPIC website. You can apply any time of year.

**EPIC – fill it out and send it**: mail or fax it to the address on the form. **No documents are needed**; EPIC checks your income with Social Security and the NYS Department of Taxation. Remember: you must have, or be able to join, a Medicare Part D drug plan to use EPIC.

**Need help with forms? Get a free counselor**: call New York's **HIICAP** line at **1-800-701-0501**, say which county or borough you live in, and you'll be connected to a free local Medicare counselor.

sources.name: 纽约州 2026 年收入标准（26MA05）
纽约州 MSP 申请表 DOH-4328 中文说明
纽约州 EPIC：申请与联系方式
纽约州老人局：HIICAP 免费 Medicare 咨询
纽约州 OTDA：申请公平听证

zh: **MSP**：交表后 **45 天内**会收到决定通知（Notice of Action），告诉你批不批。批准后**每年要续一次**；如果没收到续期信，要主动联系 HRA 或县社会服务局。
**MSP 被拒绝**：从决定起 **60 天内**可以申请公平听证（fair hearing），打通知上写的电话，或打州政府听证热线 1-800-342-3334。
**Extra Help**：会寄信告诉你结果和要付多少。如果你还没有药物计划，Medicare 会**自动帮你加入**一个 Part D 计划，你也可以自己换别的计划；有 Extra Help 的人可能**每月**都可以换一次。社安局还会把你的资料转给纽约州，帮你开始申请 MSP（除非你在表上选不要）。
**Extra Help 的有效期**：批准后当年一直有效，就算收入变了也一样；第二年继续有，除非收到信说有变化。问自己是哪一级补助，可以打 1-800-MEDICARE（1-800-633-4227）。
**EPIC**：如果不同意 EPIC 的决定（包括被拒），可以写信给 EPIC 或打热线，要求**重新考虑**（reconsideration），会收到书面答复。
en: **MSP**: within **45 days** of applying you'll get a decision letter (Notice of Action). Once approved, you must **renew every year**; if no renewal letter comes, contact HRA or your county DSS yourself.
**If MSP is denied**: you can ask for a fair hearing within **60 days** of the decision, using the phone number on your notice or the state hearing line at 1-800-342-3334.

**Extra Help**: you'll get a letter with your result and what you'll pay. If you don't have a drug plan, Medicare **enrolls you in one automatically**, and you can switch to a different plan; with Extra Help you may be able to change plans **once a month**. Social Security also sends your information to New York to start an MSP application, unless you opt out on the form.

**How long Extra Help lasts**: once approved, it lasts the rest of the year even if your income changes, and continues next year unless you get a letter saying otherwise. To ask which level you have, call 1-800-MEDICARE (1-800-633-4227).
**EPIC**: if you disagree with an EPIC decision (including a denial), write to EPIC or call the Helpline to ask for a **reconsideration**; you'll get a written answer.

zh: **三种可以一起申请**：有 MSP 就自动有 Extra Help；有全额 Extra Help 的人，EPIC 的年费也会免掉。
**寄出的所有表格都先复印一份**，写下寄出日期。
**申请都是免费的**。不要付钱给人代办，也不要相信打电话来要你社安号或红蓝卡号码的陌生人。
**每年秋天**看看你的药物计划还适不适合，不懂可以打 HIICAP 1-800-701-0501 免费咨询。
en: **You can get more than one**: MSP gives you Extra Help automatically, and people with full Extra Help don't pay the EPIC yearly fee.
**Copy every form before you send it** and write down the date you mailed it.
**Applying is free.** Don't pay anyone to apply, and don't trust strangers who call asking for your Social Security or Medicare number.
**Every fall**, check whether your drug plan still fits you; for free advice call HIICAP at 1-800-701-0501.

title.zh: 粮食券（SNAP）

short.zh: 每月充值到卡里买食物；2026年移民资格有大变化
short.en: Monthly food money on a card; big 2026 changes for immigrants

summary.zh: 粮食券（SNAP）每月把钱充到 EBT 卡上，在超市买食物用。2026 年 10 月起单人每月最多 **$306**、4 人最多 **$1,023**。联邦新法收紧了移民资格和工作要求，下面先看“最新变化”。
summary.en: SNAP puts money on an EBT card each month for groceries. From October 2026 the maximum is **$306** for one person and **$1,023** for four. A federal law tightened rules for immigrants and work; read "What changed recently" first.

zh: **移民资格收窄**：现在只有**绿卡持有人**、古巴/海地入境者和自由联合国家（密克罗尼西亚等）公民可以领。难民、庇护者等**拿到绿卡之前**不再符合。纽约从 2026 年 4 月起对新申请执行，已在领的人在下次续期时生效。
**法院判决**：2026 年 9 月联邦法院判决，原本是难民或庇护、后来拿到绿卡的人，仍然符合资格，而且不用等 5 年。是否会上诉还不确定。
**工作要求**：18–64 岁、家里没有 14 岁以下孩子的成人，每月要工作、培训或做义工满 **80 小时**，否则 3 年内只能领 3 个月。纽约市 2026 年 3 月起执行。
en: **Fewer immigrants qualify**: now mainly **green card holders**, Cuban/Haitian entrants and COFA citizens. Refugees and asylees **without a green card** no longer qualify. NY applied this to new applicants from April 2026; current cases change at recertification.
**Court ruling**: in Sept 2026 a federal court ruled that people who were refugees or asylees and later got a green card still qualify, without the 5-year wait. An appeal is possible.
**Work rule**: adults 18–64 with no child under 14 at home must work, train or volunteer **80 hours a month**, or SNAP is limited to 3 months in 3 years. NYC has enforced this since March 2026.

zh: 收入标准（2025年10月–2026年9月的数字，每月税前；2026年10月起的新标准略有上调，待纽约州公布）：有工作收入的家庭约 1人 $1,957、2人 $2,644、3人 $3,332、4人 $4,019；家里有老人、残障或付托儿费的，上限更高：1人 $2,608、4人 $5,358
身份：公民、绿卡持有人（一般要满 5 年；**18 岁以下孩子、领残障福利者、工作满 40 季的人不用等**）、古巴/海地入境者
**混合身份家庭**：父母没有身份，在美国出生的孩子仍然可以领，父母可以替孩子申请，不会问父母的身份
en: Income (monthly, before tax, for Oct 2025–Sep 2026; the Oct 2026 figures are slightly higher, pending NY's notice): households with earnings about 1 person $1,957, 2 $2,644, 3 $3,332, 4 $4,019; households with a senior, disabled member or child-care costs: up to $2,608 (1) or $5,358 (4)
Status: citizens, green card holders (usually after 5 years; **no wait for children under 18, people on disability benefits, or people with 40 work quarters**), Cuban/Haitian entrants
**Mixed-status families**: U.S.-born children can get SNAP even if parents have no status; parents can apply for the children without giving their own status

zh: **先准备文件**：身份证明、全家近期收入证明（如 30 天内的工资单）、租约或房租单、水电账单。房租和水电账单可以让你**领得更多**。
**网上申请（最方便）**：打开 ACCESS HRA 网站（a069-access.nyc.gov/accesshra），或在手机下载 **ACCESS HRA** App。页面右上角可以选**简体中文**。点“申请福利”，选 SNAP。
**尽量填完整**。不会填的地方可以先空着，HRA 之后还会问你。填完按“提交”，你**签名提交的那一天就是申请日**（下班时间以后提交，算下一个工作日）。
**不会上网**：可以到 SNAP 中心（SNAP Center）当面申请，也可以请社区机构帮你填，或者打印纸质表格寄去或传真。
**用 App 上传文件**：在 ACCESS HRA App 里拍照上传，最快。也可以拿到 SNAP 中心交，或邮寄、传真。
**自己打电话做面谈**：HRA **不会打电话给你约面谈**，要你自己打。打 **718-SNAP-NOW（718-762-7669）**，周一到周五 8:30am–5pm，不用预约。接通后说 **“Chinese, please”**，会有免费中文翻译。
**面谈大约 30 分钟**，会问收入、开支、身份和家庭情况。打电话前先把文件准备在手边。官方建议**周四、周五下午**打比较容易接通。
**越早面谈越好**：申请后 **7 天内**完成面谈，才可能拿到**紧急粮食券**（expedited SNAP，加急处理）。**30 天内**还没面谈，申请会被拒绝。
**想当面谈**：任何一个 SNAP 中心都可以要求当面面谈，不管你是怎么申请的，他们**不能拒绝你**。
en: **Get documents ready**: ID, recent income proof for everyone (such as pay stubs from the last 30 days), lease or rent bill, and utility bills. Rent and utility bills can **raise your benefit**.

**Apply online (easiest)**: go to the ACCESS HRA website (a069-access.nyc.gov/accesshra) or download the **ACCESS HRA** app. You can choose **Chinese** at the top. Choose to apply for benefits, then SNAP.

**Fill in as much as you can.** You can leave hard parts blank; HRA will ask later. Press submit. **The day you sign and submit is your filing date** (after business hours it counts as the next business day).
**If you can't go online**: apply in person at a SNAP Center, get help from a community organization, or print the paper form and mail or fax it.
**Upload documents in the app**: taking photos in the ACCESS HRA app is fastest. You can also bring them to a SNAP Center, or mail or fax them.

**Call for your interview yourself**: HRA **will not call you to schedule it**. Call **718-SNAP-NOW (718-762-7669)**, Mon–Fri 8:30am–5pm, no appointment needed. Say **"Chinese, please"** to get a free interpreter.
**The interview takes about 30 minutes** and covers income, expenses, status and household. Keep your documents next to you. The City says **Thursday or Friday afternoon** is the best time to call.
**Do the interview early**: finish it **within 7 days** of applying to be considered for **expedited SNAP** (fast-track). If you don't finish it **within 30 days**, the application is denied.
**Want to meet in person?** Any SNAP Center must give you an in-person interview if you ask, however you applied. **They cannot turn you away.**

zh: 身份证明
全家收入证明
房租、水电账单（可以增加扣除额，领得更多）
移民身份文件（申请人本人）
en: ID
Income proof for the household
Rent and utility bills (deductions raise your benefit)
Immigration documents (for the person applying for themselves)

zh: “领了粮食券会被遣返”：粮食券不会通报移民执法；但正在申请绿卡的人，请先看《公共负担》指南
“家里有人没身份就都不能领”：有资格的家人（如美国出生的孩子）仍然可以领
“有工作就不能领”：收入不超过标准就可以，有工作的家庭标准反而较宽
en: "SNAP gets you deported": SNAP isn't an immigration enforcement tool; if you're applying for a green card, read our public charge guide first
"One undocumented member disqualifies everyone": eligible members such as U.S.-born children can still get it
"Working families can't get it": if income is under the limit you can, and working households have a higher limit
