USDA 2027 财年 SNAP 调整
纽约市 SNAP 工作要求
纽约市 SNAP 申请指南（nyc.gov）
HRA SNAP 申请常见问题
纽约州 OTDA 公平听证申请
OTDA 通知书样本（听证期限：SNAP 90 天、现金补助 60 天）

zh: **多久有结果**：一般 **30 天内**给你答复。符合紧急条件的，**7 天内**先发一次紧急粮食券。
**EBT 卡**：批准后通常 **5 个工作日内**寄到家。等不及或卡丢了，可以到任何 SNAP 中心领**临时卡**。
**怎么查进度**：登录 ACCESS HRA，在首页点 **“View My Cases”**（查看我的个案），再点 **“Show Info”**。也可以打 DSS 总机 **718-557-1399**（周一至五 8am–5pm，有翻译）。
**续期**（recertification，定期重新确认资格）：一般**每年一次**。到期前 60 天就可以办。ACCESS HRA 上显示 **“Expiring Soon”**（快到期）时，要交续期表、做面谈、交文件，否则会停发。
**被拒绝或被减少**：先看通知信上的原因。不同意可以申请**公平听证**（fair hearing，州政府复查）：SNAP 要在**通知日期起 90 天内**申请，打 **1-800-342-3334**。也可以随时重新申请。
en: **When you'll hear**: usually **within 30 days**. If you qualify for expedited SNAP, a one-time benefit comes **within 7 days**.
**EBT card**: usually mailed **within 5 business days** of approval. If you can't wait or lose it, get a **temporary card** at any SNAP Center.
**Check your status**: log in to ACCESS HRA, click **"View My Cases"** on the home screen, then **"Show Info"**. Or call the DSS OneNumber **718-557-1399** (Mon–Fri 8am–5pm, interpreters available).

**Recertification** (renewing your eligibility): usually **once a year**. You can do it up to 60 days early. When ACCESS HRA shows **"Expiring Soon"**, send the form, do the interview and send documents, or benefits stop.

**Denied or cut?** Read the reason in the notice. If you disagree, ask for a **fair hearing** (a State review) **within 90 days of the notice date** by calling **1-800-342-3334**. You can also reapply any time.

zh: **重要信件只寄到你登记的邮寄地址**，搬家后马上在 ACCESS HRA 改地址，不然会错过面谈和续期通知。
**保护 EBT 卡**：常查余额，常换密码（PIN）。不用时可以在 ebtEDGE 网站或 App 把卡**冻结**，防止被盗刷。
**全家都领 SSI** 的话，可以直接在社安局办公室申请 SNAP。
需要别人（例如子女）帮你问个案情况，要先签 HRA 的**授权同意书**（Client Consent Form）。
en: **Some important letters only go to your mailing address on file.** Update your address in ACCESS HRA right after you move, or you may miss interview and renewal notices.
**Protect your EBT card**: check your balance often and change your PIN. You can **freeze** the card in ebtEDGE when not using it to stop theft.
**If everyone at home gets SSI**, you can apply for SNAP at the Social Security office.
If someone (like your adult child) needs to ask HRA about your case, you must first sign HRA's **Client Consent Form**.

title.zh: WIC 妇婴营养补助
title.en: WIC for moms, babies and young kids

short.zh: 孕妇和5岁以下孩子，不问身份
short.en: Pregnant people and kids under 5, any status

summary.zh: WIC 给**孕妇、产后妈妈和 5 岁以下孩子**提供牛奶、婴儿配方奶粉、蔬果等食物，以及营养和喂奶指导。**不问移民身份**。正在申请绿卡的家庭，请先看《公共负担》指南。
summary.en: WIC gives **pregnant people, new moms and children under 5** milk, formula, fruits, vegetables and more, plus nutrition and breastfeeding support. **Immigration status isn't asked.** If your family is applying for a green card, read our public charge guide first.

zh: 孕妇、产后 6 个月内的妈妈、哺乳 1 年内的妈妈、5 岁以下孩子（父亲、祖父母等主要照顾者都能替孩子申请）
家里有人领白卡、粮食券或现金补助的，自动符合收入标准
en: Pregnant people, moms up to 6 months after birth (1 year if breastfeeding), children under 5; any main caregiver can apply for a child
Automatically income-eligible if someone has Medicaid, SNAP or cash assistance
Otherwise yearly income up to 185% of poverty: $29,526 (1), $40,034 (2), $50,542 (3), $61,050 (4)

zh: **先确认符合**：孕妇、生完孩子不久的妈妈、5 岁以下孩子。**不问移民身份**。
**找 WIC 办公室**：打 **Growing Up Healthy 热线 1-800-522-5006**，说 **“Chinese, please”** 要中文翻译，请他们帮你找附近的 WIC 办公室，约时间。
**或者网上登记**：打开纽约州 WIC 网站（health.ny.gov/prevention/nutrition/wic），点网页上的**聊天图标**，跟线上助手 **Wanda** 回答几个问题，它会把你转给附近的 WIC 办公室。
**也可以直接打给附近的 WIC 办公室**：办公室名单在 WIC 网站的 “WIC Offices” 页面。
**约面谈**：可以选**电话面谈**或**当面面谈**。
**准备 4 类证明，每类一份**：① 全家收入（有白卡、粮食券或现金补助通知书就可以代替）② 怀孕、哺乳或孩子的证明（如医生填的 WIC 转介表、出生证明）③ 身份证明 ④ 住址证明。
**请医生填表**：带上 **WIC 医疗转介表**（WIC Medical Referral Form）给医生，填身高、体重、验血等资料。
**参加面谈**：工作人员核对文件，给孩子或你做简单健康检查，讲营养知识，然后按你家需要定好**食物配额**。
en: **Check you qualify**: pregnant, recently gave birth, or a child under 5. **Immigration status isn't asked.**
**Find a WIC office**: call the **Growing Up Healthy Hotline at 1-800-522-5006**, say **"Chinese, please"** for an interpreter, and ask them to find a nearby WIC office and set up a time.

**Or sign up online**: open the NYS WIC website (health.ny.gov/prevention/nutrition/wic), click the **chat icon**, answer a few questions from the online assistant **Wanda**, and it connects you to a local WIC office.
**You can also call a local WIC office directly**: the list is on the "WIC Offices" page of the WIC website.
**Book an appointment**: choose **by phone** or **in person**.

**Bring 4 kinds of proof, one of each**: (1) household income (a Medicaid, SNAP or cash assistance notice can count instead) (2) proof of pregnancy, breastfeeding or the child (such as a WIC referral form from the doctor, or a birth certificate) (3) identity (4) address.
**Ask your doctor to fill in a form**: bring the **WIC Medical Referral Form** so the doctor can record height, weight, bloodwork and so on.
**Go to the appointment**: staff check your papers, do a quick health check, talk about nutrition, and set up a **food package** for your family.

sources.name: 纽约州 WIC：申请要带的文件
纽约州 WIC 办公室名单

zh: **面谈当天就知道结果**：符合的话，工作人员当场帮你开通福利。
**拿到 eWIC 卡**：像借记卡一样用，在超市和药房买 WIC 批准的食物。
**还会有营养指导**：WIC 也提供喂母乳的帮助，并可以转介你去其他服务。
**续期**（recertification，重新确认资格）：到期前要再联系你的 WIC 办公室，用同样方法再办一次。
en: **You find out at the appointment**: if you qualify, staff set up your benefits then.
**You get an eWIC card**: it works like a debit card for WIC-approved foods at grocery stores and pharmacies.
**Ongoing support**: WIC also gives nutrition counseling, breastfeeding help and referrals to other services.
**Recertification** (renewing eligibility): contact your WIC office again and go through the same steps.

zh: **一份文件可以证明好几样**：例如一封写有你名字、地址和收入的信，可以同时当身份、住址和收入证明。
**没有收入**也可以申请，签一份声明就行。
**家里有人领白卡、粮食券或现金补助**，带那张卡或通知书，就不用再交工资单。
爸爸、爷爷奶奶等**主要照顾孩子的人**，都可以带孩子去申请。
en: **One document can prove several things**: a letter with your name, address and income can count for identity, address and income.
**No income?** You can still apply by signing a statement.
**If someone has Medicaid, SNAP or cash assistance**, bring that card or notice instead of pay stubs.
Fathers, grandparents or any **main caregiver** can bring the child to apply.

title.zh: 公立学校免费早餐和午餐

short.zh: 纽约州所有公立学校学生免费，不看收入
short.en: Free for every public school student in NY

summary.zh: 从 2025–26 学年起，**纽约州所有公立学校**学生的早餐和午餐都**免费**，不看家庭收入，不问身份，**不用申请**。州政府 2027 财年预算继续拨款。
summary.en: Since the 2025–26 school year, **every public school student in New York State** gets free breakfast and lunch, regardless of income or status, **with no application**. The state's FY2027 budget continues the funding.

zh: 纽约州公立学校学生
en: Public school students in New York State

zh: **不用申请**：孩子在纽约州公立学校上学，就可以每天免费吃**早餐和午餐**。
纽约市公立学校还有免费的**课后餐**（afterschool meals）。
学校如果寄来**家庭收入表**，建议照样填好交回，可能帮学校多拿经费。
en: **No application**: if your child goes to a New York State public school, breakfast and lunch are free every day.
NYC public schools also give free **afterschool meals**.
If the school sends a **household income form**, fill it in anyway; it may help the school get more funding.

sources.name: 纽约州长 2026 年 6 月公告
纽约市公立学校：学校餐

zh: **不用等结果**：开学第一天就可以吃。
每天的**菜单**可以在纽约市教育局网站的学校餐页面查看。
孩子在学校吃饭有问题，可以先问学校办公室。
en: **Nothing to wait for**: your child can eat from the first day of school.
Daily **menus** are on the NYC Public Schools school-meals page.
If there's a problem with meals, ask the school office first.

zh: 免费吃饭**不看收入、不问身份**，请放心让孩子吃。
收入表上的资料用于学校经费统计，不是用来查身份。
en: Free meals **don't depend on income or status**; let your child eat with confidence.
The income form is used for school funding counts, not to check status.

title.zh: 现金补助和 SSI 老人残障补助金

short.zh: 收入很低时的生活费补助；65岁以上或残障可申请SSI
short.en: Help with living costs for very low income; SSI for 65+ or disabled

summary.zh: 收入很低、难以维持生活的家庭，可以向 HRA 申请**现金补助**（Cash Assistance）。65 岁以上、失明或残障且收入很低的人，可以向社安局申请 **SSI**，2026 年在纽约独居单人每月最多 **$1,081**。
summary.en: Households with very low income can apply to HRA for **Cash Assistance**. People 65+, blind or disabled with very low income can apply to Social Security for **SSI**: up to **$1,081 a month** for one person living alone in New York in 2026.

zh: 现金补助：收入和资产很低；纽约州的 Safety Net 计划对移民较宽，据法律援助机构介绍包括庇护申请中、TPS、DACA 等身份（以 HRA 确认为准）
SSI：65 岁以上、失明或残障，收入和资产很低
SSI 移民规定较严：难民和庇护者最多 7 年；绿卡持有人一般需要工作满 40 季或符合其他例外
en: Cash Assistance: very low income and assets; NY's Safety Net Assistance is broader for immigrants, reportedly including pending asylum, TPS, DACA and others (confirm with HRA)
SSI: 65+, blind or disabled with very low income and assets
SSI immigrant rules are strict: refugees and asylees up to 7 years; green card holders usually need 40 work quarters or another exception

zh: **现金补助：网上申请**。打开 ACCESS HRA（a069-access.nyc.gov/accesshra）或手机 App，选中文，申请现金补助（Cash Assistance）。**同一份申请也会帮你看能不能领白卡和粮食券。**
**也可以当面去**：到 HRA 的求职中心（Job Center，也叫 Benefits Access Center）申请。
**提交后打电话做面谈**：打 **929-273-1872**，周一到周五 8:30am–5pm。接通后说 **“Chinese, please”** 要中文翻译。
**用 App 上传文件**：HRA 有一张文件清单（W-119D，有多种语言），会告诉你要交哪些。交**复印件**，不要交原件。
**急需用钱**（例如快断电、要被赶出去）：网上申请时说明是紧急情况，可能要**当天面谈**。
**SSI：打电话约时间**。打社安局 **1-800-772-1213**（周一至五 8am–7pm），说 **“Chinese, please”**，要求**免费中文翻译**，约电话申请或到办公室申请。
**SSI 要带原件**：社安号、年龄证明、绿卡或其他移民文件、收入和银行存款证明、租约或房租收据；因残障申请的，还要医生名字、电话和用药资料。社安局**不收复印件**，看完会还给你。
**先打电话，别等文件齐**：社安局**可能把你第一次联系的日期当成申请日**。缺文件他们会给你时间补，也会帮你找文件。
en: **Cash Assistance: apply online.** Open ACCESS HRA (a069-access.nyc.gov/accesshra) or the app, choose Chinese, and apply for Cash Assistance. **The same application also checks you for Medicaid and SNAP.**
**Or go in person** to an HRA Job Center (also called a Benefits Access Center).
**After you submit, call for your interview**: **929-273-1872**, Mon–Fri 8:30am–5pm. Say **"Chinese, please"** for an interpreter.
**Upload documents in the app**: HRA's list (W-119D, in several languages) shows what you may need. Send **copies**, not originals.
**Need money urgently** (for example a shut-off or eviction)? Say it's an emergency when you apply; you may have a **same-day interview**.
**SSI: call for an appointment.** Call Social Security at **1-800-772-1213** (Mon–Fri 8am–7pm), say **"Chinese, please"**, ask for a **free interpreter**, and book a phone or office appointment.

**SSI needs originals**: Social Security number, proof of age, green card or other immigration papers, income and bank records, lease or rent receipts; for disability, doctors' names, phone numbers and medicines. Social Security **doesn't take photocopies** and gives originals back.
**Call first; don't wait for every paper**: Social Security **may use the date you first contact them as your filing date**. They give you time to bring missing papers and will help you get them.

label.zh: 社安局（可要求中文翻译）

sources.name: 纽约州 2026 年 SSI 金额
社安局：移民领取 SSI 规定
ACCESS HRA 现金补助申请常见问题
社安局：申请 SSI 要带的文件
社安局：SSI 权利与责任
OTDA 通知书样本（听证期限）

zh: **现金补助多久有结果**：一般要 **30 到 45 天**，紧急情况可能更快。
**怎么查进度**：登录 ACCESS HRA 首页查看，或打 **718-557-1399**，或打电话、亲自去求职中心问。
**现金补助批准后**：会寄 EBT 卡给你。没收到可以去中心领临时卡。要按 ACCESS HRA 上显示的日期**续期**（recertification，定期重新确认资格）。
**SSI**：社安局会**寄信**告诉你结果。
**被拒绝怎么办**：现金补助可以随时重新申请；不同意可以在**通知日期起 60 天内**打 **1-800-342-3334** 申请**公平听证**（fair hearing）。SSI 不同意一般要在 **60 天内**向社安局提出**上诉**（appeal）。
en: **Cash Assistance timing**: usually **30 to 45 days**; emergencies can be faster.
**Check status**: see your case on the ACCESS HRA home page, call **718-557-1399**, or call or visit a Job Center.
**After Cash Assistance approval**: an EBT card is mailed. If it doesn't come, get a temporary card at a center. **Recertify** (renew eligibility) by the date shown in ACCESS HRA.
**SSI**: Social Security sends the decision **by mail**.

**If denied**: for Cash Assistance you can reapply any time, or ask for a **fair hearing within 60 days of the notice date** at **1-800-342-3334**. For SSI you generally have **60 days** to **appeal** to Social Security.

zh: **现金补助被拒，不等于白卡和粮食券也被拒**，要分开看通知信。
**SSI 可以带人陪你**去社安局，帮你说明情况。
打社安局电话时，**把社安号准备好**。
现金补助的面谈错过了，会有电话和信通知你改期，**一定要回复**。
en: **A Cash Assistance denial doesn't mean Medicaid or SNAP is denied**; read each notice.
**You can bring someone with you** to Social Security to help explain.
**Have your Social Security number ready** when you call.
If you miss a Cash Assistance interview, you'll get a call and a letter to reschedule; **always respond**.

title.zh: 冬季暖气补助（HEAP）

short.zh: 2026年11月2日开放，先到先得
short.en: Opens Nov 2, 2026, first come, first served

summary.zh: HEAP 帮低收入家庭付冬天的暖气费。**2026–27 年度一般补助 11 月 2 日开放**，紧急补助 2027 年 1 月 4 日开放，**先到先得**，钱用完就停，要早申请。4 口之家年收入 $82,230 以下可以申请。
summary.en: HEAP helps lower-income households pay heating costs. **Regular HEAP for 2026–27 opens November 2**, Emergency HEAP on January 4, 2027. It's **first come, first served** until funds run out, so apply early. A family of four can earn up to $82,230 a year.

zh: 收入在标准以内（4 口之家年收入 $82,230）
领粮食券或现金补助的家庭大多自动获得
家里有 60 岁以上、6 岁以下或残障人士的，可多拿补助
en: Income under the limit ($82,230 a year for 4)
Most SNAP or cash assistance households get it automatically
Extra for households with someone 60+, under 6, or disabled

zh: **先看是不是自动有**：已经领粮食券或现金补助的家庭，**大多会自动拿到 HEAP**，不用另外申请。
**11 月 2 日起才能申请**，先到先得，**越早越好**。
**纽约市网上申请**：打开 ACCESS HRA（a069-access.nyc.gov/accesshra），选中文，申请 HEAP。用 ACCESS HRA App 拍照上传文件。
**寄信或传真**：下载 HEAP 申请表（LDSS-3421），填好寄到 **P.O. Box 1401, Church Street Station, New York, NY 10008**，或传真 **917-639-2900**。
**要纸表或问要带什么**：打 **718-557-1399**，说 **“Chinese, please”**，请他们寄申请表给你。
**当面申请**：可以去 HRA 的 HEAP 办公室或外展服务点（地址在 HRA 网站的 HEAP 地点页面）。
**可能会有电话面谈**：申请后 HRA 可能打电话给你核对资料，记得接电话。
**住在纽约市以外**：到 ny.gov/HEAP 看说明，向县社会服务局申请。长者可以打 NY Connects **1-800-342-9871** 请人帮忙。
en: **Check if you get it automatically**: most households on SNAP or cash assistance **get HEAP without applying**.
**Applications open November 2**; first come, first served, so **apply early**.
**NYC online**: open ACCESS HRA (a069-access.nyc.gov/accesshra), choose Chinese, and apply for HEAP. Upload documents with the ACCESS HRA app.
**By mail or fax**: download the HEAP application (LDSS-3421), fill it in and mail it to **P.O. Box 1401, Church Street Station, New York, NY 10008**, or fax **917-639-2900**.
**To get a paper form or ask what to bring**: call **718-557-1399** and say **"Chinese, please"**.
**In person**: go to an HRA HEAP office or outreach site (listed on HRA's HEAP locations page).
**There may be a phone interview**: HRA may call to check your information, so answer the phone.
**Outside NYC**: see ny.gov/HEAP and apply with your county social services office. Seniors can call NY Connects at **1-800-342-9871** for help.

sources.name: 纽约州长 2026 年 10 月 HEAP 公告

zh: **钱不会直接给你**：按用量收费的家庭，补助会**直接付给你家的暖气供应商**（电力、燃气或燃油公司），账单会减少。
**一般补助每个冬天只有一次**。
**快断气断电或燃油快用完**：2027 年 1 月 4 日起可以申请**紧急 HEAP**（Emergency HEAP）。
en: **The money doesn't come to you**: for households billed by usage, it's **paid straight to your heating supplier** (electric, gas or oil company), lowering your bill.
**Regular HEAP is once per winter.**
**Heat about to be shut off or running out of fuel?** **Emergency HEAP** opens January 4, 2027.
**Questions or status**: call **718-557-1399** (NYC) or the State HEAP hotline **1-800-342-3009**.

zh: **钱用完就停**，11 月一开放就申请。
家里有 **60 岁以上、6 岁以下或残障**的人，申请时一定写上，可以多拿。
暖气锅炉要清洁检查，可以问 **Clean and Tune**（暖气设备清洁保养）补助，打 **718-557-1399**。
申请时手边准备好**暖气或电费账单**，上面有账号。
en: **Funds run out**, so apply as soon as it opens in November.
If someone at home is **60+, under 6, or disabled**, say so; you can get more.
If your heating equipment needs cleaning, ask about **Clean and Tune** at **718-557-1399**.
Keep your **heating or electric bill** handy; it has your account number.

title.zh: 半价地铁巴士卡（Fair Fares）

short.zh: 18–64岁低收入纽约市民，地铁巴士半价
short.en: Half-price transit for lower-income New Yorkers 18–64

summary.zh: Fair Fares 让低收入纽约市民坐地铁和巴士**半价**。目前收入标准是联邦贫困线 **150%**，市政府已提议放宽到 **200%**（单人约 $32,000、4 人约 $66,000），尚未生效。
summary.en: Fair Fares gives lower-income New Yorkers **half-price** subway and bus rides. The income limit is **150% of the poverty line**; the City has proposed raising it to **200%** (about $32,000 for 1, $66,000 for 4), not yet in effect.

zh: 住在纽约市、18–64 岁
没有从 HRA 领全额车费、也没有其他交通优惠
en: NYC resident aged 18–64
Income up to 150% of poverty: about $23,940 (1) or $49,500 (4) in 2026
Not getting full carfare from HRA or another transit discount

zh: **先看条件**：住纽约市、18–64 岁、收入在标准以内、没有从 HRA 领全额车费，也没有其他交通优惠。
**上网申请**：打开 **nyc.gov/accessfairfares**（会进入 ACCESS HRA），选中文。没有账号先点“建立新账号”，填名字、电邮（或用户名）和密码。
**按页面提示填完申请**，提交。很多人**不用交任何文件**，系统会告诉你要不要交。
**要交文件的话，10 天内交**：用 **ACCESS HRA App** 拍照上传。**超过 10 个日历天**没交，就要重新申请。
**常用文件**：带照片的身份证件（如 IDNYC、护照、绿卡）；90 天内的纽约市住址证明（水电或电话账单、租约、银行月结单）；收入证明（去年的报税表 1040 全部页，或 30 天内的工资单）。
**选怎么用折扣**：可以等寄来的 Fair Fares OMNY 卡，也可以在 ACCESS HRA 选 **“Change Discount Selection”**，把折扣放到你自己的 OMNY 卡、信用卡/借记卡或手机上。
**不会上网**：打 **311**，或 Fair Fares 电话 **718-557-1399**（周一至五 8am–5pm），说 **“Chinese, please”** 要翻译，请人帮你申请。
en: **Check the rules**: NYC resident, 18–64, income under the limit, not getting full carfare from HRA or another transit discount.
**Apply online**: go to **nyc.gov/accessfairfares** (it opens ACCESS HRA) and choose Chinese. If you have no account, create one with your name, email (or a username) and a password.
**Follow the screens and submit.** Many people **don't need any documents**; the system tells you if you do.
**If documents are needed, send them within 10 days**: take photos in the **ACCESS HRA app**. After **10 calendar days** you must apply again.

**Common documents**: photo ID (such as IDNYC, passport, green card); NYC address proof from the last 90 days (utility or phone bill, lease, bank statement); income proof (all pages of last year's tax return 1040, or pay stubs from the last 30 days).
**Choose how to use the discount**: wait for the mailed Fair Fares OMNY card, or in ACCESS HRA choose **"Change Discount Selection"** to put it on your own OMNY card, credit/debit card or phone.
**Can't go online?** Call **311** or Fair Fares at **718-557-1399** (Mon–Fri 8am–5pm), say **"Chinese, please"**, and ask for help applying.

sources.name: Fair Fares 建议文件清单
Fair Fares OMNY 常见问题

zh: **多久有结果**：文件交齐（或 10 天期限到了）后开始审核，**最多 30 天**。结果会**寄信**给你，也会显示在 ACCESS HRA 里。
**怎么查进度**：随时登录 ACCESS HRA 的 Fair Fares 账户查看。
**拿到卡**：Fair Fares OMNY 卡在批准后 **2 到 3 个星期**寄到，**不能自己去领**。用自己的 OMNY 卡、银行卡或手机的，**批准后马上可以用**。
**批准后有效 1 年**。到期要**续期**（renewal，重新申请确认资格），尽早办；错过期限就要重新申请。
**被拒绝**：可以打电话或当面要求复查，但要在**通知日期起 14 天内**提出。
en: **Timing**: review starts once documents are in (or the 10 days pass) and takes **up to 30 days**. You get a **letter**, and the result shows in ACCESS HRA.
**Check status** any time in your ACCESS HRA Fair Fares account.
**Your card**: the Fair Fares OMNY card arrives **2 to 3 weeks** after approval and **can't be picked up**. If you use your own OMNY card, bank card or phone, **you can use it right after approval**.
**Approval lasts 1 year.** **Renew** early; if you miss the deadline you must apply again.
**Denied?** Ask for a review by phone or in person **within 14 days of the notice date**.

zh: **新卡里面是 $0**，要先充钱：可以在地铁站的 OMNY 售卡机、参与的商店，或网上 OMNY 账户充值。
**每次刷卡只扣半价**。连续 7 天内付费坐满 **12 次**，这一周剩下的车**免费**。转车免费，不算次数。
折扣只能放在**一张卡或一部手机**上，不能两样都用。
**报税表里的子女抚养费不用算**进收入。
en: **A new card has $0 on it.** Add money at OMNY machines in subway stations, at participating stores, or in your online OMNY account.
**Each tap costs half fare.** After **12 paid rides in 7 days in a row**, the rest of that week is **free**. Transfers are free and don't count.
The discount works on **one card or one phone**, not both.
**Don't count child support** as income.

title.zh: 免费报税和退税福利（EITC、儿童税抵免）
title.en: Free tax prep and tax credits

short.zh: 免费报税；有ITIN也能领纽约州儿童税抵免
short.en: Free filing; ITIN filers can get NY's child credit

summary.zh: 纽约市提供**免费报税服务**，家庭年收入 $97,000 以下（有受抚养人）或 $68,000 以下（没有）都能用，有中文服务点。很多低收入家庭能拿回**劳动所得税抵免（EITC）**，**用 ITIN 报税的家庭也能领纽约州儿童税抵免**。
summary.en: NYC offers **free tax preparation** for households earning up to $97,000 with dependents or $68,000 without, including sites with Chinese service. Many low-income workers get the **Earned Income Tax Credit**, and **ITIN filers can claim New York's Empire State Child Credit**.

zh: 免费报税（2026 报税季标准）：有受抚养人 $97,000、没有 $68,000 以下
联邦 EITC：需要社安号（SSN）；2026 税年最多 $664（没有孩子）到 $8,231（3 个以上孩子）
纽约州儿童税抵免：**SSN 或 ITIN 都可以**；2026 税年 4 岁以下每个孩子 $1,000、4–16 岁 $500
en: Free tax prep (2026 season): up to $97,000 with dependents, $68,000 without
Federal EITC: requires an SSN; tax year 2026 maximum from $664 (no children) to $8,231 (3+ children)
Empire State Child Credit: **SSN or ITIN**; tax year 2026: $1,000 per child under 4, $500 for ages 4–16

zh: **看收入是否符合**：有受抚养人 $97,000 以下，没有 $68,000 以下。
**报税季开始后找服务点**：打开纽约市免费报税网站（nyc.gov/taxprep），用 **Site Finder 地图**，按语言选**中文**，找离你近的点。
**选服务方式**：① 当面和义工一起报（至少 30 分钟）② 把文件放下，之后回来取 ③ 视频通话报税 ④ 自己用软件报，有问题打电话或发电邮问义工。
**尽早预约**：很多点的预约很快就满，有些点只接受不预约直接去（walk-in），要看地图上每个点的说明。
**带身份证件**：带照片的身份证件（IDNYC 也可以）；你、配偶、孩子的**社安卡或 ITIN**（及 ITIN 通知信）和出生日期。
**带收入文件**：W-2、各种 1099（失业金是 1099-G，社安金是 SSA-1099）；自雇的带记账本和银行月结单，**不能只估个数**。
**带其他文件**：去年的报税表、托儿费收据（要有托儿人的名字、地址、税号），如有 IP PIN 也带上。
**想退税直接进银行**：带银行**路线号和账号**，最简单是带一张**空白支票**。夫妻合报，两个人都要签名。
**有孩子的**：义工会帮你填纽约州表格 **IT-213**，申请儿童税抵免。
en: **Check income**: up to $97,000 with dependents, $68,000 without.
**When tax season starts, find a site**: go to NYC's free tax prep site (nyc.gov/taxprep), use the **Site Finder map**, and search for **Chinese**.
**Pick a service**: (1) in person with a volunteer (at least 30 minutes) (2) drop off papers and come back later (3) by video call (4) do it yourself with software and get help by phone or email.
**Book early**: many sites fill up fast, and some are walk-in only. Check each site's details on the map.
**Bring ID**: photo ID (IDNYC works); **Social Security cards or ITINs** (and ITIN letters) and birth dates for you, your spouse and children.
**Bring income papers**: W-2s and 1099s (1099-G for unemployment, SSA-1099 for Social Security); if self-employed, your records and bank statements, **not rough guesses**.
**Bring other papers**: last year's return, child-care receipts (with the provider's name, address and tax ID), and your IP PIN if you have one.
**For direct deposit**: bring your bank **routing and account numbers**, easiest as a **blank check**. If married filing jointly, both spouses must sign.
**With children**: the volunteer will fill in NY form **IT-213** for the Empire State Child Credit.

label.zh: 纽约州儿童税抵免说明

zh: “收入低就不用报税”：不报就拿不到 EITC 等退税，很多人因此少拿几千元
“报税会暴露身份”：ITIN 报税是合法的，纽约州儿童税抵免接受 ITIN
en: "Low income means no need to file": you can't get EITC refunds without filing
"Filing exposes my status": filing with an ITIN is legal and NY's child credit accepts ITINs

sources.name: 纽约市免费报税常见问题
纽约市免费报税：要带的文件

zh: **联邦退税多久到**：网上报税一般约 **3 个星期**（21 天）；寄纸质表要 **6 个星期以上**。
**领 EITC 的人**：按法律，退税要**等到 2 月中**以后才发。
**查联邦退税**：上 irs.gov/refunds 用 **“Where's My Refund”**，网上报税 24 小时后可查。要准备社安号或 ITIN、报税身份和**准确的退税金额**。
**查纽约州退税**：上纽约州税务局网站用 **Check Refund Status**，或打 **518-457-5149**。要准备社安号和申请的退税金额。
en: **Federal refund timing**: about **3 weeks** (21 days) if filed online; **6 weeks or more** if mailed.
**If you claim EITC**: by law, refunds are **held until mid-February**.
**Check your federal refund** at irs.gov/refunds with **"Where's My Refund"**, 24 hours after e-filing. Have your SSN or ITIN, filing status and **exact refund amount**.
**Check your NY refund** with **Check Refund Status** on the NY tax website, or call **518-457-5149**. Have your SSN and the refund amount you asked for.

zh: **报税单留一份**，查退税要用上面的金额。
申请自己不符合的抵免，纽约州可能要**多花几个月**才处理，照实填。
**自雇的人**先打电话问服务点能不能处理你的情况，再预约。
没有银行账户，可以打 **311** 约免费的**理财咨询中心**（Financial Empowerment Center），帮你开户。
en: **Keep a copy of your return**; you need the refund amount to check status.
Claiming a credit you don't qualify for can make NY take **months longer**; be accurate.
**If self-employed**, call the site first to make sure they can handle your return.
No bank account? Call **311** to book a free **Financial Empowerment Center** session to help open one.

title.zh: Lifeline 电话和上网优惠

short.zh: 每月上网费最多减 $9.25
short.en: Up to $9.25 off internet each month

summary.zh: Lifeline 是联邦的电话或上网优惠，每户每月上网最多减 **$9.25**，只有电话的减 $5.25。家里有人领白卡、粮食券等就符合。
summary.en: Lifeline is a federal discount of up to **$9.25 a month** on internet (or $5.25 for voice-only), one per household. You qualify if someone gets Medicaid, SNAP or similar benefits.

zh: 联邦通讯委员会（FCC）2026 年 2 月提议限制移民申请 Lifeline，**目前尚未定案**。
en: In February 2026 the FCC proposed limiting Lifeline by immigration status; **it isn't final**.

zh: 收入在贫困线 135% 以内，或家里有人领白卡、粮食券等
每户只能一个
en: Income up to 135% of poverty, or someone on Medicaid, SNAP or similar
One per household

zh: **先确认符合**：家里有人领白卡、粮食券、SSI 或公共房屋补助等，或收入在贫困线 135% 以内。**每户只能领一个**。
**准备资料**：全名、出生日期、**社安号后 4 位**、住址。
**准备证明**：福利批准信或福利网站截图（要有你的名字、项目名称、12 个月内的日期）；或收入证明，如去年的报税表、社安福利证明。
**网上申请**：在 Lifeline 官方网站（lifelinesupport.org）点申请，会进入联邦申请网站（getinternet.gov）。
**或者寄信申请**：填 Lifeline 家庭表（Household Worksheet）和申请表，寄给 Lifeline 支援中心。
**或者请电话/网络公司帮你申请**：在 lifelinesupport.org 的 **“Companies Near Me”** 页面找参加的公司，向他们要 Lifeline 申请表。
**不会填**：打 Lifeline 支援中心 **1-800-234-9473**，每天 9am–9pm（美东时间）。
en: **Check you qualify**: someone at home gets Medicaid, SNAP, SSI, federal public housing aid or similar, or income is at or below 135% of poverty. **One per household.**
**Have your details ready**: full name, date of birth, **last 4 digits of your Social Security number**, address.

**Have proof ready**: a benefit letter or a screenshot of your benefits website (showing your name, the program, and a date within 12 months); or income proof such as last year's tax return or a Social Security benefit statement.
**Apply online**: on the Lifeline site (lifelinesupport.org), click apply; it takes you to the federal site (getinternet.gov).
**Or apply by mail**: fill in the Lifeline Household Worksheet and application and mail them to the Lifeline Support Center.
**Or let a phone/internet company help**: use **"Companies Near Me"** on lifelinesupport.org and ask a company for a Lifeline application.
**Need help?** Call the Lifeline Support Center at **1-800-234-9473**, every day 9am–9pm Eastern.

sources.name: 国会研究处 Lifeline 报告

zh: **要补文件**的话，Lifeline 会联系你，告诉你怎么交。
**批准后要选公司**：联系一家参加 Lifeline 的电话或网络公司，由他们给你开通优惠，每月账单会减少。
**每年要重新确认**（recertify）：收到通知后有 **60 天**回复，不回复就会**失去优惠**，账单变贵或服务被停。可以在 lifelinesupport.org/recertify 办。
**搬家或不再符合**，要在 **30 天内**告诉你的电话或网络公司。
en: **If more documents are needed**, Lifeline will contact you and explain how to send them.
**After approval, pick a company**: contact a participating phone or internet company; they enroll you and your monthly bill goes down.

**Recertify every year**: you have **60 days** after the notice. If you don't respond you **lose the discount**, and your bill may rise or service may stop. Recertify at lifelinesupport.org/recertify.
**If you move or no longer qualify**, tell your company **within 30 days**.

zh: **免费的手机服务**（自己不用付钱的）要**每 30 天至少用一次**（打电话、发短信或上网）。
Lifeline 的规定可能因联邦新提案改变，申请前先看本页“最新变化”。
一户就是**住在一起、一起分担收入和开支**的人；同住但分开过日子的，可能算不同户。
en: **If your service is free**, use it **at least once every 30 days** (call, text or go online).
Lifeline rules may change under a federal proposal; check "What changed recently" first.
A household is people who **live together and share income and expenses**; people who live together but keep money separate may count as different households.

title.zh: 申请纽约公屋（NYCHA）

short.zh: 房租约为收入的30%，等候时间很长，要尽早排队
short.en: Rent is about 30% of income; the wait is long, so get on the list early

summary.zh: 纽约市房屋局（NYCHA）的公屋，房租约为家庭收入的 **30%**，大部分包水电暖气。申请免费、网上就能办，但轮候名单很长，官方也无法估计要等多久，所以越早申请越好。
summary.en: NYCHA public housing rent is about **30% of household income**, with most utilities included. Applying is free and online, but the waiting list is very long and NYCHA can't estimate wait times, so apply early.

zh: **Section 8 租房券目前不接受新申请**：NYCHA 和 HPD 的 Section 8 轮候名单都已关闭，只接受特定转介。网上自称“代办 Section 8”的多为骗局。
en: **Section 8 vouchers are closed to new applicants**: both the NYCHA and HPD waiting lists are closed except for specific referrals. Anyone offering to "get you Section 8" for a fee is likely a scam.

zh: **不一定要是公民**：家里至少一人是公民或有合格身份（如绿卡、难民、庇护）即可
混合身份家庭也能申请，房租会按有合格身份的人数比例计算
住在或在纽约市工作的人优先
老人公屋：单人申请须 62 岁以上；多人家庭的户主和所有成员都须 62 岁以上
en: **You don't have to be a citizen**: at least one household member needs to be a citizen or have eligible status (green card, refugee, asylee)
Mixed-status families can apply; rent is prorated by the number of eligible members
People who live or work in NYC get priority
Senior buildings: a single applicant must be 62+; in larger households the head and every member must be 62+

zh: **先准备好基本资料**：全家每个人的姓名、出生日期、社安号码（有的话）、全家一年大概收入、现在的地址和电话。申请时**不用交任何文件**。
**会上网的**：用手机或电脑打开 **selfserve.nycha.info**（ApplyNYCHA，公屋网上申请），点建立账户（register），记好用户名和密码。
登录后填写公屋申请（public housing application）：家里有几口人、收入多少、想住哪个区（borough）、为什么要申请（例如住得太挤、无家可归）。
**不会上网的**：打 NYCHA 客服中心 **718-707-7771**（周一至五 8am–5pm），请他们**寄纸本申请表**给你；或者预约到 NYCHA 接待中心（Walk-in Center），用那里的电脑机器申请。
也可以打 **311**，说 “Public Housing”，再说 “Chinese, please” 要中文翻译。
交了申请后，**30 天内**会收到一封确认信，上面有你的**个案号码（case number）**。没收到信，就打 718-707-7771 问。
把确认信和个案号码收好，拍照存在手机里。以后查进度、改资料都要用到。
搬家、换电话、收入变了、家里多了或少了人，都要**上 selfserve.nycha.info 更新**。
**每 24 个月要上网点 “Update/Renew My Case” 续一次**，不续会被移出名单；续了不会改变你原来的排队日期。留了电话或电邮的，NYCHA 会发提醒。
en: **Get your basic information ready**: each household member's name, date of birth and Social Security number (if any), your household's yearly income, and your current address and phone. **No documents are needed to apply.**
**If you can go online**: on a phone or computer open **selfserve.nycha.info** (ApplyNYCHA), click register to create an account, and write down your username and password.
After logging in, fill out the public housing application: how many people, how much income, which borough you prefer, and why you are applying (for example, overcrowding or homelessness).

**If you can't go online**: call the NYCHA Customer Contact Center at **718-707-7771** (Mon–Fri 8am–5pm) and ask them to **mail you a paper application**, or book an appointment at a NYCHA Walk-in Center and apply on a kiosk there.
You can also call **311**, say "Public Housing", then say "Chinese, please" for a Chinese interpreter.
Within **30 days** you should get a confirmation letter with your **case number**. If you don't, call 718-707-7771.
Keep the letter and case number safe and take a photo of them. You'll need them to check status or change your information.
If you move, change phone numbers, your income changes, or someone joins or leaves your household, **update it on selfserve.nycha.info**.
**Every 24 months, log in and click "Update/Renew My Case"**, or you'll be dropped from the list. Renewing keeps your original filing date. NYCHA sends reminders if you gave a phone number or email.

zh: 面谈时需要：全家人的身份证件和出生证明
社安卡或身份证明文件
收入证明（工资单、W-2、社安金或退休金信函）
目前住址证明
en: At the interview: ID and birth certificates for everyone
Social Security cards or immigration documents
Proof of income (pay stubs, W-2, benefit letters)
Proof of current address

label.zh: NYCHA 客服中心（周一至五 8am–5pm）

zh: “交钱可以插队”：NYCHA 申请完全免费，没有任何付费加快的方法
“没有身份就不能申请”：只要家里有一人有合格身份就能申请
“申请一次就不用管了”：24 个月不更新会被移出名单
en: "Pay to jump the line": applying is free and nobody can speed it up for a fee
"No status, no chance": one eligible member is enough
"Apply once and forget it": if you don't renew every 24 months you're removed

zh: **多久**：名单很长，NYCHA 说**无法估计**什么时候轮到你。排序看你的优先类别（priority code）、你选的区有没有合适大小的空房、以及你最早申请的日期。
**查进度**：登录 selfserve.nycha.info 就能看到申请状态。
**资格面谈（eligibility interview）**：轮到你时，NYCHA 资格部门会打电话约你**电话面谈**，有会说双语的工作人员。之后要交全家的**原件和复印件**：身份证明、出生证明、社安卡、移民身份证明、过去 12 个月的收入和存款记录、最近 6 个月的租金收据、租约、煤气或电费单等。
**有空房时**：NYCHA 会联系你过去 3 年的房东，并为家里 **16 岁以上**的人做犯罪背景调查。都通过后，大多数人会**得到 1 个单位的配房**（需要无障碍单位或紧急优先的有 2 个）。房租约为家庭收入的 30%（扣除可扣项目后）。
**被判不合资格**：你会收到写明原因的信。可以在**信上日期 90 天内**要求非正式听证（informal hearing），也可以到客服中心讨论。如果想以后再申请，要重新交一份新申请。
en: **How long**: the list is very long and NYCHA says it **can't estimate** when you'll be called. Order depends on your priority code, whether a right-size apartment is free in the borough you chose, and your original filing date.
**Check status**: log in to selfserve.nycha.info to see your application status.

**Eligibility interview**: when your turn comes, NYCHA's Eligibility Unit calls to schedule an **interview by phone**; bilingual staff are available. You'll then provide **originals and copies** for everyone: ID, birth certificates, Social Security cards, immigration status papers, 12 months of income and asset records, 6 months of rent receipts, your lease, and a recent gas or electric bill.

**When an apartment opens**: NYCHA contacts your landlords from the past 3 years and runs a criminal background check on household members **16 and older**. If everyone passes, most applicants get **one apartment offer** (two for accessible-unit or emergency priority). Rent is about 30% of household income after deductions.

**If found ineligible**: you get a letter explaining why. You can ask for an informal hearing **within 90 days of the letter**, or go to the Customer Contact Center to discuss it. To be considered again later, you must file a new application.

zh: NYCHA 申请**完全免费**。任何人收钱说能帮你插队或“代办 Section 8”都是骗子。
同一个家庭只交一份申请，资料要写真实；收入或人数写错，面谈时会被查出来。
把 NYCHA 寄来的所有信件放在同一个文件夹，信上有期限的事要马上办，看不懂就打 311 说 “Chinese, please” 请人帮你读。
面谈要的东西很多，**现在就开始收集**：工资单、银行月结单、租金收据，至少留 12 个月的记录。
en: Applying to NYCHA is **completely free**. Anyone who charges to move you up the list or "get you Section 8" is a scammer.
Submit only one application per household and make it accurate; wrong income or household size will be caught at the interview.
Keep every NYCHA letter in one folder. Act fast on any deadline. If you can't read a letter, call 311 and say "Chinese, please" for help.
The interview needs a lot of paperwork, so **start saving now**: pay stubs, bank statements and rent receipts, at least 12 months' worth.

title.zh: 抽签平价房（Housing Connect）

short.zh: 不论身份都能抽，房租约为收入三分之一
short.en: Open to everyone regardless of status; rent about one-third of income

summary.zh: 纽约市的平价房通过 **NYC Housing Connect** 网站抽签分配，**不论公民或移民身份都可以申请**。每个楼盘都有收入下限和上限，只有收入落在范围内才有机会。
summary.en: NYC affordable apartments are assigned by lottery through **NYC Housing Connect**, and **anyone can apply regardless of citizenship or immigration status**. Each building has a minimum and maximum income; you only qualify where your income fits both.

zh: 任何人都可以注册申请，不问身份
收入要在该楼盘的范围内。2026 年标准（年收入上限）举例：1人 80% AMI 为 $95,040、130% AMI 为 $154,440；4人 80% AMI 为 $135,680、130% AMI 为 $220,480
部分楼盘优先给老人、残障人士和本社区居民
en: Anyone can register and apply; status isn't asked
Your income must fit the building's range. 2026 examples (yearly maximum): 1 person 80% AMI $95,040, 130% AMI $154,440; 4 people 80% AMI $135,680, 130% AMI $220,480
Some buildings give priority to seniors, people with disabilities and neighborhood residents

zh: **先算好全家一年的总收入**（税前）：工资、社安金、退休金等都算。去年的报税表上大部分数字都有。
用手机或电脑打开 **housingconnect.nyc.gov**，建立账户（create account），记好电邮和密码。
填写**个人资料（profile）**：家里每个人、每份收入、存款、现在的房租。资料要真实，填完整。
点 **“See Open Lotteries”**（看正在开放的抽签）。每个楼盘都写着不同家庭人数的**收入下限和上限**，只申请你收入在范围内的楼盘。
在截止日期前点申请（Apply）。**截止前什么时候交都一样**，不是先到先得。
**每个楼盘只交一份申请**，不要同时交网上和纸本，重复申请会被取消资格。但不同的楼盘都可以申请，申请越多机会越大，全部免费。
不会上网的，可以找 **Housing Ambassadors**（市政府合作的非营利机构）免费帮你申请；也可以打 Housing Connect 热线 **212-863-7990**（可能要留言等回电）。
在网站上订阅电邮通知，有新楼盘开放时会通知你。另外留意**二次出租（re-rental）**，是先到先得的。
en: **Add up your household's total yearly income** (before tax): wages, Social Security, pensions and so on. Last year's tax return has most of these numbers.
On a phone or computer open **housingconnect.nyc.gov** and create an account. Write down your email and password.
Fill in your **profile**: every household member, every income source, savings, and your current rent. Be accurate and complete.
Click **"See Open Lotteries"**. Each building lists a **minimum and maximum income** for each household size; apply only where your income fits.
Apply before the deadline. **It doesn't matter when you apply as long as it's before the deadline**; it's not first-come, first-served.

**Send only one application per building**, and never both online and paper, or you may be disqualified. But you can apply to many different buildings, and more applications mean better odds. It's all free.
If you can't go online, a **Housing Ambassador** (a city-partnered nonprofit) can help you apply for free, or call the Housing Connect hotline at **212-863-7990** (you may need to leave a voicemail).
Sign up for email alerts for new lotteries. Also watch **re-rentals**, which are first-come, first-served.

zh: 被抽中后才需要：工资单、W-2、福利信函
银行和投资账户月结单
租房记录，可能会查信用
全家人的身份证件和出生证明
en: Only if selected: pay stubs, W-2s, benefit letters
Bank and investment statements
Rental history; credit may be checked
IDs and birth certificates for everyone

zh: “收入越低越好”：每个楼盘有收入下限，收入太低反而不合资格
“找中介可以保证抽中”：抽签是随机的，任何收费保证抽中的都是骗局
“填多一点收入比较好”：收入资料必须真实，被抽中后会严格核查
en: "Lower income is always better": each building has a minimum income too
"An agent can guarantee a win": lotteries are random; paid guarantees are scams
"Round your income up": figures must be accurate and are checked if you're selected

sources.name: NYC HDC 2026 收入与房租表
HPD：Ready, Set, Apply! 申请准备指南
HPD：NYC Housing Connect 申请指南
HPD：Housing Connect 申请指南页面

zh: **抽签**：截止后，电脑会给每份申请一个随机号码，叫**排号（log number）**。号码小的会先被联系。符合优先条件的（例如本社区居民、老人、残障人士）会先被考虑。
**多久**：要等**几个月，甚至一年或更久**。要常常登录 Housing Connect 看你的**控制面板（Dashboard）**；等的时候收入或家里人数有变化，要更新资料。
**被选中后**：会要你上传或交文件（身份证明、工资单等），做信用调查或提供交租记录，并参加**审核面谈（screening interview）**。**家里 18 岁以上要住进去的人都要去面谈**。要改时间，尽早打电话，多数要提前 24 小时。
**结果**：合格的可能直接签租约，也可能被放进**等候名单**（最长可达两年）。
**被拒绝怎么办**：拒绝信会写原因和上诉方法。**只有 10 个工作日**（从信封邮戳日期算起）可以上诉：写一封信说明为什么决定有错，附上证明文件，寄到拒绝信上的地址。上诉失败但你仍认为有错，可以在 5 个工作日内向 HPD 或 HDC 投诉。上诉期间也可以继续申请别的楼盘。
en: **The lottery**: after the deadline, a computer gives each application a random number called a **log number**. Lower numbers are contacted first. People who meet a preference (such as neighborhood residents, seniors, people with disabilities) are considered first.
**How long**: it can take **several months, even a year or longer**. Check your **Housing Connect Dashboard** often, and update your profile if your income or household changes while you wait.

**If selected**: you'll be asked to upload or provide documents (ID, pay stubs, etc.), complete a credit check or show rent payment history, and attend a **screening interview**. **Everyone 18+ who will live in the apartment must attend.** To reschedule, call as early as possible; most agents want at least 24 hours' notice.
**Result**: if you qualify you may be invited to sign a lease, or put on a **waitlist** that can last up to two years.

**If rejected**: the letter explains why and how to appeal. You have **only 10 business days from the postmark** to appeal: write a letter explaining why the decision is wrong, attach proof, and mail it to the address on the rejection letter. If the appeal fails and you still think it's wrong, you can complain to HPD or HDC within 5 business days. You can keep applying to other buildings meanwhile.

zh: **现在就把文件准备好**：全家的出生证明、社安卡、带照片的身份证，工资单、报税表、福利信函，现在的租约、租金收据、煤气或电费单。
**先存钱**：被选中后可能很快要搬，至少存够**两个月房租**（第一个月租金加押金）。也先看看你现在的租约，搬走前要提前多久通知房东。
申请完全免费，抽签是随机的。任何人收钱说能保证抽中都是骗子。
Housing Connect 的信和电邮可能是英文的，收到看不懂就马上找 Housing Ambassador 或家人帮忙，**别错过 10 个工作日的上诉期限**。
en: **Get documents ready now**: birth certificates, Social Security cards and photo IDs for everyone; pay stubs, tax returns, benefit letters; your current lease, rent receipts and a gas or electric bill.

**Save money first**: if selected you may need to move quickly, so save at least **two months' rent** (first month plus security deposit). Also check how much notice your current lease requires before moving out.
Applying is free and the lottery is random. Anyone charging money to guarantee a win is a scammer.
Housing Connect letters and emails may be in English. If you can't read one, get help from a Housing Ambassador or family right away so you **don't miss the 10-business-day appeal deadline**.

title.zh: 老人和残障人士租金冻结（SCRIE / DRIE）
title.en: Rent freeze for seniors and people with disabilities (SCRIE/DRIE)

short.zh: 62岁以上、收入5万以下，租金可以冻结不再涨
short.en: 62+ with income $50,000 or less: your rent stops going up

summary.zh: 如果你住在租金管制公寓，62 岁以上（SCRIE）或有残障（DRIE），家庭年收入 **$50,000 或以下**，而且房租超过收入的三分之一，就能申请把房租冻结在现在的水平，以后房东加租的部分由市政府抵税补上。
summary.en: If you live in a rent-regulated apartment, are 62+ (SCRIE) or have a qualifying disability (DRIE), have household income of **$50,000 or less**, and pay more than one-third of income in rent, your rent can be frozen at its current level. Future increases are covered by a city tax credit to your landlord.

zh: **2026 年租金稳定公寓全面冻租**：租金指导委员会 2026 年 6 月表决，10 月 1 日起开始的 1 年和 2 年租约**都不加租**。SCRIE/DRIE 则能让你的房租长期冻结，两者不冲突。
房东已就冻租提起诉讼，法官预计 2026 年底前裁决，在此之前冻租继续有效。
en: **2026 rent freeze for stabilized apartments**: in June 2026 the Rent Guidelines Board voted a 0% increase for 1- and 2-year leases starting October 1, 2026. SCRIE/DRIE freezes your rent long-term, so it's still worth applying.
Landlords have sued over the freeze; a judge is expected to rule by the end of 2026, and the freeze stays in place until then.

zh: SCRIE：62 岁以上，名字在租约上
DRIE：18 岁以上，并领取 SSI、SSDI、退伍军人残障金，或曾领 SSI/SSDI 而现在领残障白卡
全家年收入 $50,000 或以下
房租超过月收入的三分之一
住在租金稳定（rent-stabilized）、租金管制（rent-controlled）或其他受管制公寓；DRIE 也包括 Mitchell-Lama 等
**不适用**：NYCHA 公屋、Section 8 单位、分租和非管制公寓
en: SCRIE: 62+ and named on the lease
DRIE: 18+ and receiving SSI, SSDI, VA disability, or disability-related Medicaid after SSI/SSDI
Household income $50,000 or less
Rent more than one-third of monthly income
Rent-stabilized, rent-controlled or other regulated apartment (DRIE also covers Mitchell-Lama and similar)
**Not eligible**: NYCHA, Section 8 units, sublets, unregulated apartments

zh: **先确认资格**：62 岁以上（SCRIE）或领残障福利（DRIE），名字在租约上，全家年收入 $50,000 或以下，房租超过收入三分之一，住的是租金稳定或租金管制公寓。不确定的话，可以在 nyc.gov/rentfreeze 用资格检查工具（Eligibility Tool）。
**准备文件的复印件**（**不要寄原件**）：年龄证明（护照、出生证明、州身份证或驾照任一份）；全家去年的收入证明（报税表、1099、社安金或退休金通知、银行年结单）；租金稳定公寓要上一份和现在的租约；DRIE 还要 SSI、SSDI 等残障福利的批准信（Notice of Award）。
**网上申请最快**：打开 **nyc.gov/rentfreeze**，点 “How to apply”（如何申请），进入网上系统填写。官方说网上申请处理得比较快。
**用纸本**：在同一网站下载申请表，**有中文版**。填好后连同文件复印件，寄到申请表上印的地址。
**要当面问**：可以到财政局曼哈顿服务中心（66 John Street 3 楼），最好先在 **nyc.gov/dofappointments** 预约。
**打电话问**：拨 **311**，说 “Rent Freeze”，再说 “Chinese, please” 要中文翻译。在纽约市外打，拨 212-639-9675。
住 Mitchell-Lama 或 HDFC 合作公寓的长者申请 SCRIE，要找房屋保护发展局（HPD）：100 Gold Street, Room 7M，电话 212-863-8494。
批准后要留意：家里人数变了、搬家、或房东加收大型维修费（MCI）等新费用，都要**通知财政局**。
en: **Check that you qualify**: 62+ (SCRIE) or receiving disability benefits (DRIE), named on the lease, household income $50,000 or less, rent more than one-third of income, and a rent-stabilized or rent-controlled apartment. If unsure, use the Eligibility Tool at nyc.gov/rentfreeze.

**Make copies of your documents** (**never send originals**): proof of age (any one: passport, birth certificate, state ID or driver's license); last year's income proof for everyone (tax returns, 1099s, Social Security or pension statements, bank year-end statements); for rent-stabilized apartments, your prior and current leases; for DRIE, your SSI/SSDI or other disability Notice of Award.
**Online is fastest**: open **nyc.gov/rentfreeze**, click "How to apply" and fill in the online application. The city says online applications are processed faster.
**On paper**: download the form from the same site, **available in Chinese**. Mail it with document copies to the address printed on the form.
**In person**: go to the Department of Finance Manhattan Assistance Center (66 John Street, 3rd Floor). It's best to book first at **nyc.gov/dofappointments**.
**By phone**: call **311**, say "Rent Freeze", then "Chinese, please" for an interpreter. From outside NYC, call 212-639-9675.
Seniors in Mitchell-Lama or HDFC co-op apartments apply for SCRIE through HPD: 100 Gold Street, Room 7M, phone 212-863-8494.
After approval, **tell the Department of Finance** if your household changes, you move, or your landlord adds new charges such as a major capital improvement (MCI) increase.

zh: 现在的租约和续约
全家人去年的收入证明（报税表、社安金信函等）
年龄证明；DRIE 需要残障福利证明
en: Current lease and renewal
Last year's income proof for everyone (tax returns, benefit letters)
Proof of age; for DRIE, proof of disability benefits

label.zh: NYC Rent Freeze 官方网站

zh: “公屋也能申请”：NYCHA 和 Section 8 单位不适用
“申请了就永久有效”：要按时续期，否则会失效
“房东会因此赶我走”：这是合法福利，房东通过抵税拿回差价
en: "It covers NYCHA too": NYCHA and Section 8 units aren't eligible
"It lasts forever": you must renew on time
"My landlord will push me out": it's a legal benefit and the landlord gets a tax credit

sources.name: Rent Freeze：首次申请所需文件
NYC TAP 租客系统使用指南

zh: **从什么时候开始冻结**：批准后，从财政局**收到你申请的下一个月 1 号**起生效，房租冻结在那时的金额。
**查进度**：可以登录租客网上系统 NYC TAP（**nyc.gov/nyctap**，用寄给你的信上的 PIN 码登记），在 “Applications” 里看状态和还缺什么文件，也可以在那里上传 PDF 文件；或打 311 问。官方没有公布固定的处理时间。
**多久要续一次**：租金稳定公寓一般跟你的租约同期；租金管制公寓一般两年。到期前约 **60 天**会收到续期申请，可从到期前 60 天起在网上续。到期后 **6 个月内**续都可以补回；超过就要重新申请。连续批准满 5 年的，可以用较短的续期表。
**被拒绝怎么办**：拒绝信寄出后 **120 天内**可以用财政局的上诉表（Tenant Appeal Application）上诉，附上证明文件，寄到 NYC Department of Finance, Compliance Unit, P.O. Box 3179, Union NJ 07083。有正当理由可申请延期。同一个决定只能上诉一次。
收到决定后仍有问题，也可以联系 SCRIE 或 DRIE 的**申诉专员（ombudsperson）**；但他们不处理还在审核中的进度问题。
en: **When the freeze starts**: once approved, it takes effect on the **first day of the month after the Department of Finance receives your application**, and your rent is frozen at that amount.

**Check status**: log in to the tenant portal NYC TAP (**nyc.gov/nyctap**; register with the PIN from your letter) and open "Applications" to see the status and any missing documents. You can upload PDFs there too, or call 311. The city doesn't publish a fixed processing time.

**How often to renew**: for rent-stabilized apartments it usually matches your lease; for rent-controlled apartments it is usually two years. You'll get a renewal form about **60 days** before it ends and can renew online from 60 days before. You can still renew up to **6 months after** it expires and be covered back to the end date; after that you must apply again from scratch. If you've been approved 5 years in a row, you can use a shorter renewal form.

**If denied**: you can appeal **within 120 days** of the decision letter on the Department's Tenant Appeal Application, with supporting documents, mailed to NYC Department of Finance, Compliance Unit, P.O. Box 3179, Union NJ 07083. You can ask for more time with good cause. You can appeal the same decision only once.
After you get a decision, you can also contact the SCRIE or DRIE **ombudsperson**; they don't handle questions about applications still being processed.

zh: **今年全面冻租也要申请 SCRIE/DRIE**：今年的冻租只管这一轮租约，SCRIE/DRIE 能长期保住你的房租。
寄任何东西都**只寄复印件**，自己留一套，并记下寄出的日期。
把财政局寄来的信都放好，特别是**续期信**；到期前 60 天就开始续，不要拖到最后。
因为生病住院、残障等原因来不及续期，可以打 311 或填写残障延期申请表，要求延长时间。
en: **Apply even with this year's rent freeze**: that freeze covers only this round of leases, while SCRIE/DRIE protects your rent long-term.
**Only ever mail copies**, keep a set for yourself, and note the date you mailed them.
Keep every letter from the Department of Finance, especially **renewal letters**. Start renewing 60 days before the end date; don't wait until the last minute.
If illness, hospitalization or a disability keeps you from renewing on time, call 311 or file the disability extension request form to ask for more time.

title.zh: 被房东告上法庭：免费律师（Right to Counsel）
title.en: Facing eviction: free lawyer (Right to Counsel)

short.zh: 收入在贫困线2倍以内，被告驱逐可免费请律师
short.en: Free eviction lawyer if income is under 200% of poverty line

summary.zh: 在纽约市，如果房东在房屋法庭（Housing Court）告你欠租或要你搬走，收入在联邦贫困线 **200% 以内**的家庭可以**免费请律师全程代表**，**不论移民身份**。收入较高的也可以得到免费法律咨询。
summary.en: In NYC, if your landlord takes you to Housing Court for unpaid rent or to evict you, households under **200% of the federal poverty line** get a **free lawyer for the whole case, regardless of immigration status**. Others can get free brief legal advice.

zh: 住在纽约市的租客，包括 NYCHA 居民
全家收入在联邦贫困线 200% 以内可获全程代表：2026 年约 1 人 $31,920、4 人 $66,000
收入较高者可获简短法律咨询
不问移民身份
en: NYC tenants, including NYCHA residents
Full representation if income is under 200% of poverty: about $31,920 for 1 person and $66,000 for 4 in 2026
Brief advice for others
Immigration status doesn't matter

zh: **收到法庭文件不要怕，也不要丢**。看清楚是哪种案子：欠租案（nonpayment）还是要你搬走的案子（holdover）。看不懂就马上找人帮你读。
**欠租案要在收到文件后 10 天内答辩（answer）**：带着法庭文件和你的身份证件，到房屋法庭的书记官柜台（clerk's office）**口头答辩**就可以，书记官会给你一个出庭日期。holdover 案一般在开庭时答辩，但要看文件上有没有要求更早答辩。
**马上打电话找免费律师**：拨 **311**，说 “Tenant Helpline”，再说 “Chinese, please” 要中文翻译；或打 Housing Court Answers **212-962-4795** 或 **718-557-1379**（周一至五 9am–5pm）。
也可以发电邮到 **civiljustice@hra.nyc.gov**，写上你的名字、电话和法庭案件号（index number，有的话）。
**第一次出庭一定要去**，提早到，要过安检。到了法庭跟法庭人员说 **“I would like an attorney”**（我要一位律师），或找戴着青绿色 “Speak with a free lawyer” 徽章的人。免费律师的审核通常就在第一次出庭当天或之后不久。
**法庭提供免费翻译**：开庭时告诉法庭人员你需要中文（普通话或粤语）翻译。
**带齐文件**：法庭文件、租约和续约、交租证明（汇票存根、支票、银行月结单、收据）、收入证明。
如果在第一次开庭前**付清全部欠租**，欠租案就必须结束。需要租金补助的，可以问律师或 311。
en: **Don't panic and don't throw the court papers away.** Check what kind of case it is: nonpayment (unpaid rent) or holdover (asking you to move out). If you can't read them, get help right away.

**In a nonpayment case, answer within 10 days of receiving the papers**: bring the papers and your ID to the Housing Court clerk's counter and **answer out loud**; the clerk will give you a court date. In a holdover case you usually answer at the hearing, but check whether the papers ask for an earlier answer.

**Call for a free lawyer right away**: call **311**, ask for the "Tenant Helpline", then say "Chinese, please" for an interpreter; or call Housing Court Answers at **212-962-4795** or **718-557-1379** (Mon–Fri 9am–5pm).
You can also email **civiljustice@hra.nyc.gov** with your name, phone number and your Housing Court index number (if you have one).

**Always go to your first court date.** Arrive early for security. Tell court staff **"I would like an attorney"**, or look for someone wearing the teal "Speak with a free lawyer" button. Screening for a free lawyer usually happens on or shortly after the first court date.
**The court provides free interpreters**: tell court staff you need a Chinese (Mandarin or Cantonese) interpreter.
**Bring your papers**: court papers, lease and renewals, proof of rent paid (money order stubs, checks, bank statements, receipts) and proof of income.
If you **pay all the rent owed before the first court date**, a nonpayment case must end. Ask your lawyer or 311 about rent assistance.

zh: 法庭文件（Petition、Notice）
租约和交租记录
收入证明
en: Court papers (petition, notice)
Lease and rent receipts
Proof of income

zh: “房东可以自己换锁赶人”：在纽约这是违法的，只有法院执行官才能执行驱逐
“没身份不能上法庭”：房屋法庭不问身份，也不会通报移民局
en: "My landlord can change the locks": illegal in NY; only a court marshal can evict
"Without status I can't go to court": Housing Court doesn't ask about immigration status

sources.name: HRA：租客法律服务（Right to Counsel）
纽约州法院：答辩（Answering a Case）
纽约州法院 CourtHelp：纽约市欠租案
纽约州法院：免费翻译服务

zh: **有律师之后**：律师会代表你跟房东谈或上庭。案子先在调解庭（Resolution Part）处理，谈不拢才转到审判庭（Trial Part），由法官听证据后判决。
**没有分到全程律师**：法律机构可能只能给你建议，教你自己处理案子。法官也可以为特别弱势的租客特别要求安排律师。
**没去法庭或没答辩**：房东可以拿到**缺席判决（default judgment）**，再找法院执行官（marshal）驱逐你。
**收到执行官通知（Marshal's notice）**：不要等，**马上**联系律师或 Housing Court Answers，你可能还能撤销缺席判决或暂停驱逐。
en: **Once you have a lawyer**: they speak with the landlord or appear in court for you. Cases start in the Resolution Part; if not settled they go to a Trial Part, where a judge hears evidence and decides.

**If you don't get full representation**: a legal provider may only be able to advise you on handling the case yourself. A judge can also make a special request for a lawyer for a particularly vulnerable tenant.
**If you don't answer or don't come to court**: the landlord can get a **default judgment** and then use a city marshal to evict you.
**If you get a marshal's notice**: don't wait. Contact a lawyer or Housing Court Answers **right away**; you may still be able to undo the default or stop the eviction.
To check a court date, call the Housing Court in your borough: Manhattan 646-386-5500, Brooklyn 347-404-9201, Queens 718-262-7145, Bronx 718-466-3025, Staten Island 718-675-8452.

zh: 免费律师（Right to Counsel）**不收任何费用**。有人自称律师却跟你要钱，多半是骗子。
一直保留交租证明：用汇票或支票交租，留好存根；付现金一定要收据。
房东自己换锁、断水断电赶你走是违法的。被锁在门外，打 311 或 Housing Court Answers。
自己请私人律师的话，要找专门做房屋法的律师。
en: Right to Counsel lawyers are **free**. Anyone claiming to be your lawyer who asks for money is likely a scammer.
Always keep proof of rent paid: pay by money order or check and keep the stubs; get a receipt for cash.
A landlord changing the locks or cutting utilities to force you out is illegal. If you're locked out, call 311 or Housing Court Answers.
If you hire a private lawyer, choose one who specializes in housing law.

title.zh: 老人住房：老人公屋和老人平价楼

short.zh: 62岁以上可申请老人公屋、HUD 202 老人楼和老人抽签房
short.en: 62+: NYCHA senior buildings, HUD 202 buildings and senior lotteries

summary.zh: 62 岁以上的长者有三条路：NYCHA **老人公屋**、联邦 **HUD 202** 老人楼（直接向每栋楼排队），以及 Housing Connect 上**优先给老人的抽签楼盘**。三条路可以同时走。
summary.en: Seniors 62+ have three routes: NYCHA **senior buildings**, federal **HUD Section 202** buildings (apply to each building's waitlist), and **senior-priority lotteries** on Housing Connect. Use all three at once.

zh: NYCHA 老人公屋：单人 62 岁以上，或全家都 62 岁以上；收入和身份规定同一般公屋
HUD 202：至少一人 62 岁以上，收入一般低于地区中位收入 50%；很多楼同时有 Section 8 补贴，对移民身份有要求，请向每栋楼确认
Housing Connect 老人楼盘：按各楼盘规定
en: NYCHA senior buildings: single applicant 62+ or everyone 62+; same income and status rules as public housing
HUD 202: at least one member 62+, income generally under 50% AMI; many buildings also have Section 8 subsidies with immigration-status rules, so ask each building
Senior lotteries on Housing Connect: rules vary by building

zh: **三条路一起走**，越早排队越好：NYCHA 老人公屋、HUD 202 老人楼、Housing Connect 老人抽签楼盘。
**NYCHA 老人公屋**：上 **selfserve.nycha.info** 申请公屋，在选择楼宇时选老人楼（Senior Development）。不会上网，打 **718-707-7771** 请他们寄纸本表格。
记住老人公屋的年龄规定：单人要 62 岁以上；两人以上的家庭，户主和所有成员都要 62 岁以上。
**HUD 202 老人楼**：每栋楼自己管名单，要**一栋一栋**打电话或去管理处登记。打 **Aging Connect 212-244-6469**，说 “Chinese, please”，请他们帮你找附近的老人楼。
问每栋楼时，问清楚：收入上限多少、对移民身份有什么要求、名单开不开放、怎样登记、要不要定期更新。
**Housing Connect**：在 **housingconnect.nyc.gov** 建立账户，留意写着 senior（老人）的楼盘，收入符合就申请；可以申请很多个。
把每个名单的**申请编号、日期、电话**写在同一张纸上，放在家里显眼的地方，也给子女一份。
地址、电话改了，**每个名单都要更新**，不然通知寄不到你。
en: **Use all three routes at once**, and start early: NYCHA senior buildings, HUD 202 senior buildings, and senior lotteries on Housing Connect.
**NYCHA senior buildings**: apply for public housing at **selfserve.nycha.info** and choose a Senior Development. If you can't go online, call **718-707-7771** for a paper form.
Remember the age rule: a single applicant must be 62+; in larger households the head and every member must be 62+.

**HUD 202 buildings**: each building keeps its own list, so contact them **one by one**. Call **Aging Connect at 212-244-6469**, say "Chinese, please", and ask for help finding senior buildings near you.
Ask each building: What is the income limit? What immigration status is required? Is the list open? How do I sign up? Do I need to renew?
**Housing Connect**: create an account at **housingconnect.nyc.gov**, watch for lotteries marked senior, and apply wherever your income fits. You can apply to many.
Write each list's **application number, date and phone** on one sheet of paper, keep it somewhere easy to see, and give a copy to your children.
If your address or phone changes, **update every list**, or you'll miss their letters.

label.zh: Aging Connect 老人服务热线

zh: “老人楼只收公民”：不一定，各楼规定不同，混合身份家庭也值得逐栋询问
“只能排一个名单”：可以同时登记多个名单
en: "Senior buildings are for citizens only": not necessarily; rules vary by building, so mixed-status families should ask each one
"Only one list at a time": you can be on several lists

sources.name: HPD：Ready, Set, Apply! 申请准备指南

zh: **NYCHA**：30 天内收到确认信和个案号码；**每 24 个月上网续一次**；轮到时会电话面谈，要交原件。被判不合资格，90 天内可以要求非正式听证。
**Housing Connect**：截止后随机给排号，可能要几个月甚至一年以上才有消息；被选中要交文件、面谈；被拒绝**只有 10 个工作日**上诉。
**HUD 202 老人楼**：每栋楼的名单、等候时间和联系方式都不同，要按那栋楼的要求定期跟进。
所有名单都等很久，等的时候可以先申请 **SCRIE 租金冻结**（如果住在受管制公寓），保住现在的房租。
en: **NYCHA**: a confirmation letter with your case number comes within 30 days; **renew online every 24 months**; when your turn comes there's a phone interview and you provide originals. If found ineligible, you can ask for an informal hearing within 90 days.

**Housing Connect**: after the deadline you get a random log number; it may take months or over a year to hear back. If selected you provide documents and interview. If rejected, you have **only 10 business days** to appeal.
**HUD 202 buildings**: each building's list, wait and contact method differ, so follow up as that building requires.
Every list is long. While you wait, apply for the **SCRIE rent freeze** (if you live in a regulated apartment) to protect your current rent.

zh: 排名单**全部免费**。有人收钱说能帮你优先排进老人楼，就是骗子。
有子女或邻居帮忙的话，请他们帮你开一个电邮，并帮你看英文信件。
混合身份家庭不要先放弃，每栋楼的身份规定可能不同，逐栋问清楚。
同时也可以打 Aging Connect，问送餐、居家照顾等老人服务。
en: Getting on any list is **free**. Anyone charging to put you ahead for a senior building is a scammer.
If children or neighbors can help, ask them to set up an email for you and help read English letters.
Mixed-status families shouldn't give up early; status rules may differ by building, so ask each one.
While you're at it, call Aging Connect about meals, home care and other senior services.

title.zh: 老人中心、送餐和老人服务
title.en: Older adult centers, meals and senior services

short.zh: 60岁以上免费：老人中心午餐、活动、上门送餐
short.en: Free for 60+: center meals, activities, home-delivered meals

summary.zh: 纽约市 60 岁以上长者可以免费到**老人中心**吃饭和参加活动，餐点会配合社区口味，很多华人区中心提供中餐。行动不便的可以申请**上门送餐**。一个电话 Aging Connect 就能查。
summary.en: New Yorkers 60+ can eat and join activities at **older adult centers** for free, with meals that fit the community's culture. Those who can't get out can get **home-delivered meals**. Start with one call to Aging Connect.

zh: 纽约市 60 岁以上居民
上门送餐：60 岁以上、外出困难，需经评估
en: NYC residents 60+
Home-delivered meals: 60+ and homebound, after an assessment

zh: **先打 Aging Connect（老人服务热线）**：**212-AGING-NY（212-244-6469）**。接通后说 “Chinese, please”，等中文翻译接上。
跟接线员说清楚你需要什么：例如“我想找附近有中餐的老人中心”或“我出门困难，想申请送餐”。
**找老人中心**：也可以上 NYC Aging 网站，点 “Find a center near you”（找附近的中心），输入你的地址。
**直接去老人中心**：60 岁以上**免费参加**。第一次去时问工作人员：几点吃饭、要不要登记、有什么活动（太极、椅子操、电脑班、一日游等）。每个中心的时间和服务都不一样。
**申请上门送餐**：打 Aging Connect，或直接联系你住的社区的个案管理机构（case-management agency），先**电话登记（intake）**。
之后个案经理（case manager）会**到你家拜访**，评估你是否符合资格，并帮你安排服务。准备好你的身份证明、地址和健康状况，方便回答问题。
个案经理还能帮你**申请福利**、介绍社区资源、安排义工探访（Friendly Visiting）。
en: **Start with Aging Connect**: call **212-AGING-NY (212-244-6469)**. When connected, say "Chinese, please" and wait for the interpreter.
Tell them what you need, for example: "I want an older adult center near me with Chinese meals" or "I have trouble going out and want home-delivered meals."
**To find a center**: you can also go to the NYC Aging website, click "Find a center near you" and enter your address.

**Visit a center**: it's **free for people 60+**. On your first visit ask the staff: When are meals? Do I need to register? What activities are there (tai chi, chair exercise, computer classes, day trips and more)? Schedules and services differ by center.
**For home-delivered meals**: call Aging Connect or contact the case-management agency for your neighborhood for a **phone intake**.
A case manager will then **visit your home** to check eligibility and arrange services. Have your ID, address and health information ready.
Case managers can also help you **apply for benefits**, connect you to community resources and arrange a Friendly Visiting volunteer.

zh: **送餐**：个案经理家访后决定你是否符合资格，再帮你安排送餐。
**费用**：个案经理不收费。有些服务会按收入请你付费或自愿捐款，具体问个案经理。
**居家照顾**：NYC Aging 资助的居家照顾包括个人护理（洗澡、穿衣）和家务（洗衣、买东西）；**已经有白卡（Medicaid）的人不能用这项**，要走白卡的居家照顾渠道。
情况变了（例如身体变差、需要更多帮忙），再打 Aging Connect 或联系你的个案经理。
en: **Meals**: after the home visit, the case manager decides if you qualify and arranges the meals.
**Cost**: case managers don't charge. For some services you may be asked for a fee or a suggested contribution based on income; ask your case manager.
**Home care**: NYC Aging-funded home care covers personal care (bathing, dressing) and housekeeping (laundry, shopping); **people on Medicaid can't use it** and should use Medicaid home care instead.
If things change (for example your health gets worse and you need more help), call Aging Connect or your case manager again.

zh: 老人中心是交朋友、学东西的好地方，不只吃饭。可以请朋友一起去。
打热线时手边准备纸笔，记下接线员的名字、日期和对方说的下一步。
老人中心**对所有 60 岁以上的纽约市民免费开放**，不要因为不会英文而不敢去。
家人住得远的，可以替你打 Aging Connect 登记，再让个案经理直接联系你。
en: Older adult centers are a great place to make friends and learn, not just eat. Bring a friend.
Keep a pen and paper by the phone; write down the staff member's name, the date and the next step.
Older adult centers are **free and open to all New Yorkers 60+**; don't stay away because you don't speak English.
Family who live far away can call Aging Connect for you, and the case manager can then contact you directly.

title.zh: 纽约市身份证 IDNYC

short.zh: 免费、不问身份的市政府身份证
short.en: Free city ID regardless of immigration status

summary.zh: IDNYC 是纽约市政府发的**免费身份证**，10 岁以上的纽约市居民都能办，**不问移民身份**。可以用来进出政府大楼、在部分银行开户、去图书馆，还有博物馆等优惠。
summary.en: IDNYC is a **free photo ID** from the City for residents 10+, **regardless of immigration status**. Use it to enter city buildings, open accounts at some banks, use libraries and get museum and other discounts.

zh: 住在纽约市、10 岁以上
不问移民身份
en: NYC residents age 10+
Immigration status doesn't matter

zh: **先查文件够不够**：IDNYC 用**分数制**，身份证明要凑够 **3 分**，住址证明要 **1 分**。用 IDNYC 网站上的 **Document Calculator**（文件计算器）选你有的文件，它会告诉你够不够。
**拿申请表**：可以在 IDNYC 网站打印，也可以在办理中心拿。
**预约**：上 IDNYC 网上预约系统，或打 **311** 说 **“IDNYC”**，再说 **“Chinese, please”** 要中文翻译。**每周五**放出下一周（周一到周五）的名额。
**每人只约一次**，不要重复预约。
**不想预约**：有些办理点在固定日子接受直接去（walk-in），**先到先得**，早点去排队。
**带原件去办理中心**：IDNYC **不接受邮寄申请**。工作人员看完文件，当场**还给你原件**，并给你**拍照**。
**10–13 岁孩子**：要有照顾人陪同。孩子带 2 分的身份文件（含出生日期）；照顾人带自己 3 分的身份文件（含带照片的证件），以及和孩子关系的证明，并在申请表上签名。
en: **Check your documents**: IDNYC uses **points**. You need **3 points** for identity and **1 point** for address. Use the **Document Calculator** on the IDNYC site to see if yours are enough.
**Get the application**: print it from the IDNYC site or pick one up at a center.
**Book an appointment**: use the IDNYC online portal, or call **311**, say **"IDNYC"**, then **"Chinese, please"** for an interpreter. **Every Friday** new slots open for the next Monday–Friday.
**Book only one appointment per person.**
**No appointment?** Some centers take walk-ins on set days, **first come, first served**; go early.
**Bring originals to the center**: IDNYC **doesn't accept mail applications**. Staff check your papers, **give them back right away**, and **take your photo**.

**Children 10–13**: come with a caretaker. The child brings 2 points of identity (with birth date); the caretaker brings 3 points of their own ID (including photo ID) plus proof of their relationship, and signs the form.

zh: 身份证明：护照、外国身份证、领事证等
纽约市住址证明：水电账单、租约、银行月结单等
en: Identity: passport, foreign ID, consular ID, etc.
NYC address: utility bill, lease, bank statement, etc.

zh: **卡寄到家**：批准后 **10–14 个工作日**寄到。
**没有固定地址或担心安全**：可以选择到指定的 IDNYC 地点**自己领卡**。
**续期**（renewal，换新卡）：卡到期前 **60 天**到过期后 **6 个月**内都可以办，可以在 IDNYC 网上系统办，也可以带文件去中心办。
en: **Card by mail**: arrives **10–14 business days** after approval.
**No stable address or safety concerns?** You can choose to **pick up the card** at certain IDNYC locations.
**Renewal**: from **60 days before** to **6 months after** the expiration date, online through the IDNYC portal or in person with documents.

zh: **周五一早**就上网或打 311 抢名额，好时段很快约满。
外国护照、领事证等都可以算身份证明，**不用有美国身份**。
住址证明要写着**你的名字和纽约市地址**，例如水电账单、租约、银行月结单。
卡**有效 5 年**（16 岁以下 2 年），记下到期日，提前续期。
en: **Go online or call 311 early on Friday**; good times fill up fast.
Foreign passports and consular IDs count for identity; **you don't need U.S. status**.
Address proof must show **your name and NYC address**, such as a utility bill, lease or bank statement.
The card is **valid 5 years** (2 years under 16); note the date and renew early.

title.zh: 免费 3-K 和 Pre-K 幼儿园

short.zh: 3岁和4岁孩子免费上学，不问收入和身份
short.en: Free school for 3- and 4-year-olds, any income or status

summary.zh: 纽约市为 **3 岁（3-K）和 4 岁（Pre-K）**的孩子提供**免费**全日制学前教育，**不论家庭收入、移民身份或语言**。每年年初截止申请，网上申请有中文版。
summary.en: NYC offers **free** full-day school for **3-year-olds (3-K) and 4-year-olds (Pre-K)**, **regardless of income, immigration status or language**. Applications close early in the year; the online form is available in Chinese.

zh: 当年满 3 岁或 4 岁、住在纽约市的孩子
不问收入和身份
en: NYC children turning 3 or 4 that year
No income or status requirement

zh: **看孩子哪年出生**：2027 年秋天入学，**2023 年出生**的孩子上 Pre-K，**2024 年出生**的上 3-K。
**留意开放时间**：下一轮预计 **2027 年初**开放（2026 年是 2 月 27 日截止）。截止前申请，**都会得到学位**，不是先到先得。
**网上申请**：打开 **MySchools（myschools.nyc）**，选中文，建立账号，加上孩子的资料。
**选学校**：把你想去的幼儿园按喜欢的顺序排好。**可以填很多个**，没有数量限制，多填几个更容易进到满意的学校。
**截止前可以改**：提交后在截止日之前还能修改。
**不会上网**：打 **718-935-2009**，有 200 多种语言翻译，说 **“Chinese, please”**；或到家庭欢迎中心（Family Welcome Center）请人帮你申请。
en: **Check your child's birth year**: for fall 2027, children **born in 2023** go to Pre-K and **born in 2024** go to 3-K.
**Watch for the opening**: the next round is expected to open in **early 2027** (the 2026 deadline was February 27). Everyone who applies by the deadline **gets an offer**; it's not first-come.
**Apply online**: go to **MySchools (myschools.nyc)**, choose Chinese, create an account and add your child.
**Choose programs**: list the programs you want in order of preference. **There's no limit**, so listing more helps you get one you like.
**You can make changes** until the deadline.
**Can't go online?** Call **718-935-2009** (interpreters in 200+ languages; say **"Chinese, please"**) or visit a Family Welcome Center for help.

zh: **什么时候知道结果**：往年**5 月**发录取通知（2026 年 Pre-K 是 5 月 12 日、3-K 是 5 月 19 日）。
**接受学位**：按通知信上的日期接受，并去学校**预先注册**（pre-register），要带的文件看教育局的预先注册清单。
**候补名单**（waitlist）：没进到第一志愿的，整个夏天都可能接到学校的候补通知。
en: **When you'll hear**: offers usually come in **May** (in 2026, Pre-K on May 12 and 3-K on May 19).
**Accept the offer** by the date on your offer letter and **pre-register** at the school; see the NYC Public Schools pre-registration checklist for documents.
**Waitlists**: if you didn't get your top choice, schools may contact you from the waitlist through the summer.
**Questions**: call **718-935-2009**, or call **311** and ask about "3-K" or "Pre-K for All".

zh: **不看收入、不问身份**，放心申请。
排序要**按真心想去的顺序**，不要把“容易进”的放前面。
把 2027 年初的申请时间记在日历上，**别错过截止日**。
en: **No income or status check**; apply with confidence.
Rank programs **in the order you really want them**, not by which seems easier to get.
Mark the early-2027 application dates on your calendar so you **don't miss the deadline**.
